client.name: Cummins Arabia
client.legal_name: Cummins Arabia (Cummins Saudi Arabia Limited, Cummins Arabia FZCO, Cummins Kuwait); 50:50 JV of Cummins Inc. and The Olayan Group
client.employees: Over 550 professionals (Cummins press release, April 2025); close to 500 employees of 30 plus nationalities at launch (June 2017)
client.revenue: Cummins Arabia revenue not published. Parent Cummins Inc. FY2025 revenue USD 33.7 billion, net income USD 2.8 billion; Power Systems segment sales USD 7.463 billion (investor.cummins.com, 2026-02-05)
client.sector: Distribution, sales and service of Cummins diesel and gas generator sets (2.5 kW to 3500 kW), engines, filtration, parts, BESS and HHP rebuild in Saudi Arabia, UAE and Kuwait
client.positioning_text: Cummins Arabia is the exclusive Cummins distribution and service JV for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait, formed in 2017 by Cummins Inc. and Olayan, whose Cummins distribution history in Saudi Arabia dates to 1956. It runs 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a service training centre with 550 plus staff. Its competitive position in Gulf power generation rests on the Cummins HHP range (QSK60, QSK78, QSK95 and the new Centum Series) for 60 Hz Saudi and 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait data centres, the PowerCommand controls and DMC paralleling family, and the 2025 addition of factory BESS. The 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale delivery and the first EMEIA BESS commissioning in Dubai are its current reference points

movements.headline: Cummins Arabia completes DMC6000 master controller retrofit for a Riyadh telecom operator
movements.summary: Three 800 kW QSK23-G3 gensets at a major network and communication service provider in Riyadh moved from a 20 year old MC-150 master controller to a PowerCommand DMC6000 with PCC3300 upgrades, completed in a six week shutdown window under Cummins Arabia supervision.

relevance.analysis: Installed-base modernisation is a repeatable revenue line in KSA telecom and data centre sites running legacy PowerCommand controls. Cummins Arabia can package DMC6000 retrofits with service contracts as a defensive move against competitor replacement offers.

movements.headline: Cummins launches containerised BESS in the UAE through Cummins Arabia
movements.summary: Cummins Power Generation, Cummins Arabia and Cummins Middle East launched the LFP battery energy storage range in Dubai, with Amit Deshpande (Managing Director) and Emad Lotfy (Power Generation Business Director) quoted. Cummins Arabia was described as 550 plus staff, 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a training centre across UAE, KSA and Kuwait.

relevance.analysis: Gives Cummins Arabia a hybrid genset plus storage offer for rental, data centre and oil and gas customers before most genset competitors in the Gulf have a factory-branded BESS with genset controller integration. The 50 Hz only listing means KSA 60 Hz sites need confirmation of a 60 Hz variant.

movements.headline: Cummins Arabia publishes 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale data centre reference
movements.summary: Thirty DQLC and six DQCA enclosed gensets (36 units, 73.2 MW) were delivered in seven months to a regional technology provider's hyperscale sites across Saudi Arabia, engineered for 50 C ambient with remote radiators, dual ACB panels, Ni-Cad batteries and fuel coolers, tested to Uptime Institute requirements.

relevance.analysis: This is the proof point for 60 Hz QSK78 supply into KSA hyperscale programmes. The case study states the customer recommended Cummins Arabia for future phases, so follow-on capacity should be protected with reserved production slots given Cummins Inc reports record data centre order books.

movements.headline: Cummins announces S17 Centum 17 litre genset up to 1000 kW
movements.summary: New S17 engine based Centum Series (C600D6E to C1000D6ED, 60 Hz, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency) with 25,000 plus hours of validation and a three year base warranty, aimed at commercial, healthcare and water treatment standby.

relevance.analysis: A 1 MW class set on a 17 L block cuts footprint and fuel against 23 L to 30 L competitors in the 600 to 1000 kW band that dominates KSA hospital, commercial and telecom tenders. Cummins Arabia should confirm 60 Hz availability for Africa Middle East and price it against Cat C18 and mtu 12V1600 class units.

movements.headline: Cummins reports FY2025 revenue of USD 33.7 billion; Power Systems sales USD 7.46 billion
movements.summary: Full year 2025 revenue USD 33.7 billion (down 1 percent), net income USD 2.8 billion, EBITDA USD 5.4 billion. Power Systems segment sales USD 7.463 billion with EBITDA USD 1.694 billion (22.7 percent); Q4 Power Systems sales up 11 percent on data centre demand in North America, China and Asia Pacific.

relevance.analysis: Power Systems is the growth engine of the parent, but the cited demand regions do not include the Middle East. Cummins Arabia competes internally for HHP allocation; documented Gulf pipeline visibility is what secures slots against North American and Asian data centre orders.

movements.headline: First Cummins BESS in EMEIA commissioned at Cummins Arabia Al Quoz, Dubai
movements.summary: A C400B5ZE (422 kWh / 200 kW) was commissioned in Q3 2025 at Cummins Arabia's Al Quoz facility for peak shaving alongside containerised diesel gensets; Q4 2025 results were 12.7 MWh discharged, 382 generator hours and 5,443.5 litres of diesel avoided.

relevance.analysis: A live, metered hybrid reference on Cummins Arabia's own site is the demonstration asset for rental fleets, remote oil and gas camps and construction sites in the UAE and KSA. The measured fuel and runtime savings give the sales team quantified payback material.

movements.headline: Cummins raises 2030 targets and announces large-engine capacity and product investments at Analyst Day
movements.summary: At its 2026 Analyst Day Cummins raised 2030 financial targets and announced further capacity and product investments to strengthen positioning in mining and power generation; Power Systems President Jenny Bush said demand for reliable power is accelerating at an unprecedented pace. Dollar and GW figures are in the presentation, not the release.

relevance.analysis: Added HHP capacity is the constraint that decides whether Cummins Arabia can bid multi-hundred megawatt KSA data centre phases on schedule. Cummins Arabia should lock forward allocation agreements for QSK78 and QSK95 sets while capacity ramps.

movements.headline: Cummins to supply HSK78G and QSK60 gas gensets for Circe Energy HPC data centres in West Texas
movements.summary: Behind-the-meter prime power natural gas microgrids for AI and HPC data centres using HSK78G (C2000N6CD) and QSK60 (C1400N6) gensets, deliveries 2026 to 2030 with modular deployment from 2027.

relevance.analysis: Gas prime power for data centres is now a Cummins reference model. In KSA and the UAE, where pipeline gas is available at industrial sites, Cummins Arabia can propose HSK78G prime power or bridging power for data centre and industrial loads waiting on grid connections.

movements.headline: Cummins introduces QSK78 Centum Series to the 50 Hz market
movements.summary: New 50 Hz HHP Centum gensets on the QSK78 platform, up to 3500 kVA standby and 3300 kVA continuous for data centres, with PowerCommand 3400, Centum Transmission Drive, Tier 2 and Low NOx options and HVO compatibility, announced from Daventry, UK for Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and Latin America.

relevance.analysis: Extends the data-centre-optimised Centum footprint to the 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait markets where the C2750D5 and C3000D5 previously carried the QSK78 range. Cummins Arabia should obtain the model data sheets and position the 3300 kVA continuous rating against Cat 3516E and mtu 20V4000 offers in UAE hyperscale tenders.

movements.headline: Cummins Q2 2026: Power Systems sales up 19 percent to USD 2.3 billion, outlook raised
movements.summary: Q2 2026 revenue USD 9.5 billion (up 9 percent), net income USD 932 million, EBITDA 17.5 percent. Power Systems sales USD 2.3 billion (up 19 percent) with EBITDA USD 552 million (24.5 percent) on robust data centre standby orders; full year revenue growth guidance raised to 10 to 13 percent.

relevance.analysis: Strong global order intake tightens HHP lead times and pricing power for the parent. For Cummins Arabia the implication is lead time discipline in Gulf bids and early engagement with consultants so that Saudi and UAE projects are in the order book before slots fill.

movements.headline: Cummins wins 5 MWh BESS supply for a large US data centre
movements.summary: Cummins selected to supply LFP battery energy storage systems with 5 MWh nominal capacity for a large US data centre project, its largest BESS deployment to date, to manage AI-driven load fluctuations and support utility interconnection requirements.

relevance.analysis: Validates BESS as a data centre product line, not only a remote-power line. Cummins Arabia can bundle BESS with genset blocks in KSA and UAE data centre proposals to address load-following and interconnection ramp requirements.

movements.headline: HSK78G certified for hydraulic fracturing (EPA Tier 2 mobile off-highway)
movements.summary: The 78 litre, 12 cylinder HSK78G natural gas engine, rated 3000 bhp, received EPA Tier 2 large spark-ignition mobile off-highway certification for well servicing, joining the Spark-Ignited Pumping Power portfolio.

relevance.analysis: Relevant to Cummins Arabia's oil and gas engine business as Saudi unconventional gas programmes expand; also confirms the HSK78G platform's power density that underpins the C2000N gas genset range offered in the Gulf.

competitors.positioning_text: Caterpillar is the incumbent premium power generation brand in the Gulf, selling through two long-standing exclusive dealers: Zahid Tractor in Saudi Arabia (Cat dealer since 1950, 22 to 24 branches) and Mohamed Abdulrahman Al-Bahar in the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (headquartered in Sharjah, Oman covered through associate Oasis Trading). Its Gulf reach is reinforced by the Zahid Group rental arm Altaaqa, the largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world at over 1 GW, and by Caterpillar's own Middle East Distribution Center, district office and Learning Center in Jebel Ali. Globally, Cat is converting the AI data centre boom into record backlog and is tripling large reciprocating engine capacity to about three times 2024 levels by 2030, which means the 3516E, C175 and G3520K nodes that compete head on with Cummins in the 1.5 to 4 MW band will be more available and more aggressively marketed in the region from 2027

movements.headline: Zahid Tractor marks 75 years as Caterpillar's Saudi dealer at Jeddah flagship branch
movements.summary: Zahid Tractor and Caterpillar executives, key clients and employees from across the Kingdom gathered at the Jeddah flagship branch to mark 75 years of the dealership, coinciding with Caterpillar's 2025 centennial.

relevance.analysis: The Zahid relationship is the deepest dealer franchise in the Kingdom and is not going to be disrupted. Cummins Arabia should not expect Cat account churn in KSA from dealer instability; wins have to come on product, lead time and service economics.

movements.headline: Joule, Caterpillar and Wheeler agree 4 GW data centre power in Utah on G3520K gensets with 1.1 GWh BESS
movements.summary: Joule Capital Partners, Caterpillar and dealer Wheeler Machinery announced an agreement for 4 GW of total energy for a 4,000 acre data centre campus in central Utah, using G3520K gas gensets with combined cooling heat and power and 1.1 GWh of grid-forming battery storage, launch targeted 2026.

relevance.analysis: This is the template Cat will bring to Gulf data centre developers: gas gensets as prime power plus BESS in one dealer-led package. Cummins Arabia needs an equivalent prime power gas plus storage story for Saudi and UAE campuses before Cat dealers pitch it.

movements.headline: Caterpillar launches Cat D1500 1.5 MW compact diesel genset on C32B engine
movements.summary: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.

relevance.analysis: A 1.5 MW node on a 32 litre engine attacks the footprint and weight argument in the 1,500 to 1,875 kVA class where Cummins sells QSK50 based sets in Saudi 60 Hz projects. Watch for a 50 Hz and Middle East release; until then it is a North America product.

movements.headline: Caterpillar commits USD 725 million to expand Lafayette large engine plant for 3500 series power generation engines
movements.summary: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.

relevance.analysis: The 3512 and 3516 are the engines behind the gensets Cummins Arabia meets most often in Gulf tenders. More 3500 capacity shortens Cat lead times from 2027, which removes one of the few advantages Cummins has held while Cat allocated engines to US hyperscalers.

movements.headline: Q3 2025: record USD 17.6 billion sales, Energy & Transportation USD 8.4 billion (+17%), backlog USD 39.8 billion led by data centre customers
movements.summary: Caterpillar posted all-time Q3 sales of USD 17.6 billion, Energy & Transportation sales of USD 8.4 billion up 17%, backlog up USD 2.4 billion in the quarter mainly from data centre customers, and full-year tariff cost guidance of USD 1.6 to 1.75 billion.

relevance.analysis: Backlog growth driven by data centres means Cat factory slots are being consumed by US hyperscalers. In the near term this leaves room for Cummins Arabia on lead time in the Gulf; the window narrows as Cat capacity comes online.

movements.headline: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar exhibit together at ADIPEC 2025 in Abu Dhabi
movements.summary: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar shared stand 9430 at ADIPEC 2025 (3 to 6 November, ADNEC), showcasing high-efficiency engines, rebuild programmes and data-driven lifecycle solutions for oil and gas customers.

relevance.analysis: Cat is keeping its oil and gas power and marine franchise warm with ADNOC-ecosystem buyers through the dealer. Cummins Arabia should track ADNOC and Lamprell type accounts where Al-Bahar has installed 3500 series sets and target the rebuild and CVA renewal cycle.

movements.headline: Zahid Tractor runs 2026 Sales Campus with Caterpillar management at Zahid Business Park
movements.summary: Three-day Sales Campus (13 to 15 January 2026) for the full Zahid sales organisation, product support, SMD and Ejar rental divisions with Caterpillar management and instructors, built around a customer-back approach, VisionLink, Cat Inspect and uptime guarantees.

relevance.analysis: Zahid is standardising a digital, uptime-guarantee sales motion across machines, power and rental in the Kingdom. Cummins Arabia should expect connected-asset and uptime-guarantee terms to appear in Saudi genset bids and should have PowerCommand Cloud and service-level commitments ready as standard.

movements.headline: AIP Corp, Caterpillar and Boyd CAT form alliance for 2 GW of G3516 gas gensets plus BESS at Monarch Compute Campus, 8 GW planned
movements.summary: American Intelligence & Power Corp announced 2 GW of fast-response Cat G3516 natural gas gensets with battery storage and SCR for a West Virginia AI campus, deliveries September 2026 to August 2027, 2 GW online 2027, 8 GW planned in total.

relevance.analysis: Cat's G3516 is being positioned as prime power infrastructure, not standby. If Gulf hyperscale developers such as those building for Humain or Khazna adopt behind-the-meter gas, Cat arrives with a referenceable multi-GW installed base. Cummins Arabia should build its own gas prime power references now.

movements.headline: FY2025 results: Power Generation above USD 10 billion (+30%), Q4 power generation +44%, Middle East called out as strong, 2026 tariff cost USD 2.6 billion, price realisation about +2%
movements.summary: Q4 2025 Power & Energy sales USD 9.4 billion (+23%), profit USD 1.841 billion; CEO said Power Generation exceeded USD 10 billion in 2025 with growth above 30% and that the Middle East continues to be really strong; 2026 tariff cost guided at about USD 2.6 billion with roughly 2% favourable price realisation for the year.

relevance.analysis: Cat leadership sees the Middle East as a strong market entering 2026 and is pushing price up about 2% while absorbing tariffs. Cummins Arabia has a pricing window on US-built product costs; it should quantify landed cost differences per node and sell that to Saudi and UAE buyers before Cat mitigates.

movements.headline: Caterpillar, OnePWR Solutions and Vero3 collaborate on 500 MW gas power with carbon capture for data centres
movements.summary: Caterpillar supplies generation and leads front-end engineering for carbon capture, OnePWR builds, owns and operates, Vero3 handles CO2 storage; inaugural project targets 500 MW of prime power launching in 2026.

relevance.analysis: Gas plus carbon capture is a decarbonisation answer Gulf regulators and NEOM-type clients will ask for. Cummins Arabia has no equivalent bundled offer; it should decide whether to partner for capture or lean on HVO and hydrogen-ready messaging.

movements.headline: PROPWR signs framework with Caterpillar for at least 1.5 GW of gas generation assets, option to about 2.1 GW
movements.summary: ProPetro's PROPWR division agreed to buy at least 1.5 GW of Caterpillar power generation assets over five years with an option to about 2.1 GW, for about 2.6 GW operating by end 2031 including 550 MW already ordered, serving data centres, oil and gas and industry.

relevance.analysis: Cat is locking multi-year framework volume with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf equivalents (Altaaqa, Aggreko type players and Saudi IPP developers) are the accounts where Cummins Arabia should propose its own multi-year fleet frameworks before Cat dealers do.

movements.headline: Q1 2026: Caterpillar triples large reciprocating engine capacity plan to about 3x 2024 levels, adds about 15 GW per year, power generation +48%
movements.summary: Q1 2026 sales USD 17.4 billion (+22%), Power & Energy USD 7 billion (+22%), power generation sales +48%; large engine capacity plan raised from 2x to nearly 3x 2024 levels with investment mainly 2027 to 2029, about 15 GW of additional annual capacity; large engine backlog up 3.5x since January 2024; tariff cost guidance cut to USD 2.2 to 2.4 billion; six agreements of at least 1 GW each announced; EAME outlook noted softening anticipated in the Middle East.

relevance.analysis: This is the structural threat. By 2028 Cat will have far more 3500, C175 and G3500 engine supply than today and will need non-US outlets for it, and the Gulf is the obvious one. Cummins Arabia should lock multi-year supply agreements and service contracts with key Saudi and UAE accounts in 2026 and 2027 while Cat is still capacity constrained.

movements.headline: Zahid Tractor publishes updated Saudi branch map (22 to 24 branches) and a 75 years of partnership campaign

relevance.analysis: Zahid's network already covers every Saudi industrial cluster including the northern and southern regions where Cummins Arabia has thinner coverage. Any Cummins Arabia branch plan should be checked against this map to avoid opening where Cat service is already dense and to prioritise gaps.

movements.headline: US state data centre moratoria (New York EO 62, New Jersey cost-sharing law) trigger Baird downgrade, CAT falls over 6%
movements.summary: New York signed a moratorium on hyperscale data centres above 50 MW pending review and New Jersey passed a cost-sharing law; at least 12 states have moratorium bills; Baird downgraded Caterpillar citing regulatory risk to power generator demand.

relevance.analysis: If US data centre permitting slows, Cat will redirect gensets and sales focus to the Gulf where Saudi and UAE AI campuses face no such moratoria. That raises competitive intensity in KSA and UAE from late 2026. Cummins Arabia should assume more aggressive Cat dealer pricing on large nodes.

movements.headline: Q2 2026: first USD 20 billion quarter, power generation +72%, backlog USD 72 billion, 10 MW medium-speed gas engine production restarted for 1.5 GW
movements.summary: Sales USD 20.5 billion (+24%), Power & Energy USD 8.2 billion (+17%) with 24.6% margin, power generation retail sales +72% on large gensets and turbines for data centres, backlog USD 72 billion (+92%), 2026 guidance raised to mid to high teens growth, USD 392 million IEEPA tariff recovery booked, and production of a 10 MW medium-speed gas engine restarted with shipments from Q4 2026 targeting 1.5 GW.

relevance.analysis: The 10 MW medium-speed gas platform fills the gap between Cat high-speed gensets and Solar turbines, directly bracketing Cummins HSK78G and QSK95 gas offers for Gulf industrial and utility prime power. Cummins Arabia should expect Cat to bid gas plants at 10 to 100 MW in Saudi and Kuwait with a single-OEM stack by 2027.

movements.headline: Stella Power orders large quantity of Solar Turbines Titan 130 packages for data centre and industrial onsite power
movements.summary: Stella Power Company placed a large order for PGM130 packages (Titan 130 gas turbine, over 16 MW each, 90 second start, 2 ppm NOx capable) from Caterpillar's Solar Turbines for onsite power at data centres, industrial sites and oil and gas in North America.

relevance.analysis: Cat can offer turbines above the reciprocating band, so in Gulf prime power tenders above 20 MW it can shift the buyer from gensets to turbines. Cummins Arabia should hold the reciprocating advantages (part-load efficiency, modular redundancy, N+1 flexibility) in its bid narrative.

movements.headline: Energy Vault signs 1.25 GW integrated power deal in Texas for a hyperscaler with an EPC deploying Caterpillar gensets
movements.summary: Energy Vault's largest contract to date: 1.25 GW of integrated power infrastructure in Texas for an AI data centre, with a power generation EPC deploying Caterpillar gensets and Energy Vault grid-forming BESS, initial deployments within 4 to 12 months.

relevance.analysis: Third-party BESS integrators are packaging Cat gensets by default. In the Gulf, Cummins Arabia should court the BESS integrators and EPCs (not just end users) so that Cummins is the default genset in their bills of material.

partnerships.partner: Zahid Tractor & Heavy Machinery Co. Ltd. (Zahid Group)
partnerships.scope: Sole Cat dealer for Saudi Arabia covering machines, engines, electric power, marine, oil and gas and Cat mining; 22 to 24 branches; engine rebuild centres Jeddah and Dammam; embedded site technicians on strategic projects

why_it_matters.analysis: Seventy-five years of relationships with Aramco, SEC, giga-project developers and contractors give Cat first call on Saudi power tenders. Cummins Arabia competes against a dealer with more service points than it has; the counter is faster quotes, guaranteed lead times and total cost of ownership at the node level.

partnerships.scope: Cat dealer for UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (Oman via associate Oasis Trading); power systems sales, packaging, rental power with nine regional depots, CVAs, switchgear, UPS, ATS and load banks

why_it_matters.analysis: Al-Bahar is the direct competitor to Cummins Arabia in UAE and Kuwait for every hospital, metro, oil and gas and data centre standby package. Its rental fleet lets it seed accounts with temporary power and convert to permanent Cat sets, a motion Cummins Arabia should match with its own rental partners.

partnerships.scope: Largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world, over 1 GW, 62 kVA to 2,000 kVA, six depots plus 17 Zahid branches, turnkey rental power plants for oil and gas, mining, cities and remote sites

why_it_matters.analysis: Every MW Altaaqa deploys is a Cat MW and often becomes a permanent Cat sale. Cummins Arabia should target the rental buyers who want a second OEM for fleet resilience and price competition, and should protect its own rental partner relationships in KSA.

partnerships.scope: Caterpillar International Power Projects partner for 20 to 100+ MW temporary power plants across Africa, Middle East, Latin America and Asia, Dubai based

why_it_matters.analysis: Gives Cat a utility-scale temporary power channel that Cummins Arabia does not have in the Gulf. Relevant when Kuwait MEW or Saudi utilities seek bridging power; Cummins Arabia should partner with an IPP-style rental operator for those tenders.

partnerships.scope: Cat Rental Store franchise in Saudi Arabia with mobile generator sets among rental lines; locations include Makkah and Dammam; part of Zahid's 2026 Sales Campus organisation

why_it_matters.analysis: Small and mid-size rental gensets feed contractor relationships that later specify permanent standby sets. Cummins Arabia should ensure its C-series and QSK rental units are positioned with Saudi contractors through its own rental channel.

partnerships.partner: Red Sea Global (The Red Sea Project)
partnerships.scope: 69 Cat gensets, 32 MW prime power, B100 biodiesel capable, Cat Connect remote monitoring and CVAs supplied by Zahid Tractor for construction phase power

why_it_matters.analysis: Cat holds the incumbent position on the Red Sea giga-project and its renewable fuel narrative. For permanent power phases (hotels, airport), Cummins Arabia should bid with HVO-compatible sets and hybrid microgrid options before the incumbent locks the follow-on.

partnerships.scope: About 5,000 Cat machines on site with CVAs, technician training and 24/7 support through Zahid Tractor; power generation scope not stated

why_it_matters.analysis: Zahid's machine footprint at NEOM gives it daily access to NEOM procurement. Cummins Arabia should not assume genset packages at NEOM are open competitions; it needs early engagement with NEOM's energy and data centre teams.

partnerships.scope: 6 MW hybrid microgrid in Sharjah: 2.7 MW Cat PV, five Cat 3412 gensets (3.24 MW), Cat ESS 286 kWh/250 kW, Cat Master Microgrid Controller; 2020 follow-on with 3516E 50 Hz and 60 Hz HV ratings

why_it_matters.analysis: Al-Bahar has a live UAE reference for single-supplier solar, genset and storage integration. Cummins Arabia should have a comparable hybrid reference in UAE or KSA to avoid losing agri, industrial and remote-site microgrid tenders on integration credibility.

partnerships.scope: Five Cat 3516C (1530 ekW, 60 Hz, 600 V) and one 3512C (1310 ekW) for the first of two LeTourneau Super 116E jack-up rigs, commissioned by Al-Bahar 2022-11

why_it_matters.analysis: Cat owns the UAE offshore rig power niche through Al-Bahar. Cummins Arabia's marine and drilling engines could target the second rig and future ADNOC Drilling newbuilds if it can show class approvals and local commissioning capacity.

partnerships.partner: Dubai Roads and Transport Authority (Dubai Metro)
partnerships.scope: 20 Cat gensets (8 x 3516, 8 x 3512, 2 x C18, 2 x C15, 50 Hz, 320 to 1,820 kW) for emergency backup, with installation, training and three-year maintenance contract via Al-Bahar

why_it_matters.analysis: The Dubai Metro fleet is now 15 years old and approaching replacement or major overhaul cycles. Cummins Arabia should position for RTA replacement and Route 2020 extension standby packages where an incumbent-only assumption may be weak.

partnerships.partner: American Intelligence & Power Corp and Boyd CAT
partnerships.scope: 2 GW of G3516 fast-response gas gensets plus BESS and SCR for the Monarch Compute Campus, 8 GW planned, deliveries 2026-09 to 2027-08

why_it_matters.analysis: Establishes Cat gas gensets as prime power for AI campuses at multi-GW scale. Gulf hyperscale developers will benchmark against this. Cummins Arabia needs a documented gas prime power reference and a partner BESS to stay on shortlists.

partnerships.partner: Joule Capital Partners and Wheeler Machinery
partnerships.scope: 4 GW data centre campus power in Utah on G3520K gensets with CCHP and 1.1 GWh grid-forming BESS, launch targeted 2026

why_it_matters.analysis: Confirms the G3520K as Cat's flagship data centre prime power node. Cummins Arabia should prepare a node-by-node comparison of HSK78G against G3520K on efficiency, start time and footprint for Gulf ambient conditions.

partnerships.scope: Framework for at least 1.5 GW, option to about 2.1 GW, of Cat gas generation assets over five years for data centres, oil and gas and industry

why_it_matters.analysis: Shows Cat's willingness to sign multi-year volume frameworks with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf oilfield service and rental operators are the analogue; Cummins Arabia should offer framework pricing and priority allocation to lock them first.

partnerships.scope: Gas generation plus carbon capture, BESS and permanent CO2 sequestration for data centres; inaugural 500 MW prime power project launching 2026

why_it_matters.analysis: Gas with capture is a credible answer to Gulf sustainability procurement criteria. Cummins Arabia should decide on a capture or offset partner or risk being screened out on carbon in NEOM and UAE net-zero aligned campuses.

competitors.read: Caterpillar is the incumbent spec in Gulf data centres, giga-projects and Aramco sites, sold through Zahid Tractor (22 Saudi branches, dealer since 1950) and Al-Bahar (UAE, Kuwait). Altaaqa's 1 GW Cat rental fleet absorbs outage-driven demand before any sale is tendered. Cat's large-engine capacity is being consumed by US AI builds through 2027, so delivery slots in the Gulf are the field where Cummins Arabia can move.

competitors.name: Rolls-Royce Power Systems (mtu)
competitors.employees: More than 10,350 worldwide at end of 2025; around 700 hires in 2025 and over 1,000 positions to be filled in 2026 (Rolls-Royce Power Systems results release, 2026-02-27)
competitors.revenue: EUR 5.72 billion in FY2025 (+19%), adjusted operating profit EUR 995 million, return on sales 17.4%, order intake EUR 7.14 billion (+21%). Reported in GBP by Rolls-Royce Holdings as Power Systems underlying revenue GBP 4,892 million and underlying operating profit GBP 852 million. H1 2026: underlying revenue GBP 2,604 million (+28% organic), operating profit GBP 528 million, margin 20.3%, order intake GBP 4.6 billion (+55%), book-to-bill 1.8x
competitors.sector: Large diesel and gas engines, diesel and gas generator sets 40 kW to 4,000 kVA, dynamic UPS (Kinetic PowerPack), battery energy storage (EnergyPack), marine, rail and defence propulsion
competitors.positioning_text: Rolls-Royce Power Systems is the premium German engine OEM behind the mtu brand and one of the three largest suppliers of emergency power to data centres worldwide, with power generation revenue up 30% in 2025 and 41% in H1 2026 on data centre demand. Its Gulf go-to-market runs through Rolls-Royce Solutions Middle East FZE in Jebel Ali (set up as MTU Middle East in 2015) plus three distributors: Al Masaood Power Division in the UAE and Bahrain (mtu since 1978, exclusive UAE distributor since 1982), Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen), an Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur JV that became exclusive stationary power distributor for Saudi Arabia on 2025-10-01, and Al Mulla Power Solutions in Kuwait (sole distributor since 2024-12-22). The KSA and Kuwait channels are young: Makeen's stationary power mandate is one year old and Kuwait's mtu MRO centre in Ahmadi completes only in September 2026, while the UAE channel is mature and already wins airport and data centre work. Product range against Cummins Arabia is concentrated in the 1,600 to 4,000 kVA Series 4000 band plus the gas 20V4000 and the Kinetic PowerPack, with global genset capacity doubling in the US in 2026 and a new Series 4000 assembly plant in Friedrichshafen from 2028

movements.summary: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.

relevance.analysis: This pushes mtu down into the 600 to 1,000 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in volume for UAE and Kuwait 50 Hz projects. mtu's argument is data centre grade load factors and HVO approval on a compact 22 litre engine. Cummins Arabia should hold the position on price, lead time and local stock, which mtu's distributors cannot match in this band.

movements.headline: USD 24 million Mankato expansion to lift Series 4000 genset output by more than 120% by 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce announced a new Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, Minnesota to raise Series 4000 generator set production more than 120% by 2026 versus the prior year, adding over 100 jobs. Data centre sales grew almost 50% in 2024; Stratmann said hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years.

relevance.analysis: Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on. More 60 Hz Series 4000 capacity shortens the lead times mtu can quote into Saudi data centre and industrial tenders from 2026. Cummins Arabia's 60 Hz lead-time advantage in KSA narrows as this ramps.

movements.headline: USD 75 million Aiken, South Carolina expansion to machine Series 4000 engines in the US from July 2027
movements.summary: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.

relevance.analysis: A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year. Monitor mtu lead-time quotes in KSA and UAE from 2027.

movements.headline: MTU Yuchai Power JV in Suzhou adds Series 2000 G06 and Series 4000 S83 production, 3,000 engines built to date
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.

relevance.analysis: Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf. Cummins Arabia already competes with Chinese packaged Cummins engines from Cummins' own China plants; mtu now has a comparable lever. Watch for Suzhou sourced mtu gensets appearing in UAE and KSA rental and construction tenders.

movements.headline: 50 mtu 12V4000 R64 engines ordered for Saudi Arabia's Dammam to Riyadh high-speed trains
movements.summary: Stadler ordered 50 mtu Series 4000 rail engines (1,500 kW each, EU Stage V) for 10 trains running up to 200 km/h, with an option for 40 more. The release stresses operation in extreme heat and sand.

relevance.analysis: Not a genset sale, but it puts 50 plus Series 4000 engines into Saudi Arabia with a service obligation, which strengthens the case for a Makeen Series 4000 parts and MRO base in the Eastern Province. That base would also serve stationary Series 4000 gensets sold against Cummins Arabia's QSK60 and QSK78 range.

movements.headline: Rolls-Royce and Microsoft publish joint position paper on HVO for data centre backup power
movements.summary: The paper positions HVO as a drop-in fuel cutting lifecycle CO2 by up to 90% on approved diesel gensets, written for the Singapore data centre sector with Microsoft's APAC cloud ESG team. Quoted: Ostermaier and Spadaro.

relevance.analysis: A published Microsoft co-authorship is a hyperscaler endorsement mtu will reuse in UAE and Saudi data centre bids where Microsoft, and the operators building for it, specify backup fleets. Cummins Arabia should be ready with its own HVO approval documentation for the QSK series when hyperscaler specs arrive.

movements.headline: Largest ever mtu battery order: 582 MWh / 291 MW EnergyPack for Ignitis in Lithuania
movements.summary: Three BESS sites at wind farms and a pumped storage plant, operational from 2027, controlled by mtu EnergetIQ Manager. Rolls-Royce cites over 200 mtu battery storage projects delivered worldwide.

relevance.analysis: mtu's BESS business is grid-scale and utility-led, unlike Cummins' BESS positioning. The relevance for Cummins Arabia is hybrid genset plus storage tenders in KSA and UAE, where mtu can now show half-gigawatt-hour references and its own controller. Cummins Arabia should track EnergyPack quotes into Saudi utility and NEOM-type microgrid work.

movements.headline: Fast-start mtu 20V4000 gas gensets for data centre prime and backup power, 45 second start from 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.

relevance.analysis: This targets the same grid-constrained data centre prime power need that Cummins addresses with the HSK78G and QSK95 gas sets, and the 60 Hz variant is built for markets like Saudi Arabia. In UAE and KSA data centre campuses where gas is available, mtu can now bid diesel backup, gas prime and dynamic UPS as one package. Cummins Arabia should lead with HSK78G efficiency and Cummins' Gulf gas service record before mtu's 60 Hz set ships.

movements.headline: Makeen becomes exclusive mtu distributor for stationary power across Saudi Arabia
movements.summary: Effective 2025-10-01, Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen) extended its exclusive mtu distributorship from mobile applications to stationary power across the Kingdom, covering genuine parts, factory-certified MRO and integrated power solutions.

relevance.analysis: For the first time mtu gensets have an exclusive Saudi channel owned by Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur, with a localisation licence behind it. That combination speaks directly to Aramco, SEC, NEOM and IKTVA-scored buyers that Cummins Arabia sells to. Cummins Arabia's answer is installed base, 60 Hz stock and its own local content record; it should expect Makeen to appear in Eastern Province industrial and data centre tenders within 12 months.

movements.headline: Seven mtu 20V4000 DS3600 gensets for Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce is supplying seven 20-cylinder Series 4000 DS3600 backup gensets through local partner Al Mulla Power Systems for the Limak-built Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works. Units are specified for 55 C ambient, delivery early 2026 then commissioning.

relevance.analysis: This is mtu's first public Kuwait win through the new Al Mulla channel and it lands in the 3 MVA class where Cummins Arabia sells C3000 and C3500 class sets. A government airport reference plus a Turkish EPC relationship (Limak) gives mtu credibility for the next Kuwait infrastructure packages. Cummins Arabia should map Limak and other Turkish EPC procurement teams active in Kuwait and KSA.

movements.headline: Five-year guaranteed Series 4000 capacity agreement with UK packager AVK
movements.summary: Framework agreement secures Series 4000 emergency genset production capacity for AVK, exclusive mtu integrator for UK and Ireland, for five years, focused on HVO-ready data centre gensets. AVK has taken over 600 mtu gensets in the past decade.

relevance.analysis: Rolls-Royce is pre-selling Series 4000 capacity to European data centre packagers. That is good for Cummins Arabia in the short term because it leaves less uncommitted mtu volume for Gulf distributors, but it also signals mtu will prioritise hyperscaler channel partners; if a Gulf packager gets a similar deal, treat it as a direct threat.

movements.headline: First emergency gensets with verified Environmental Product Declarations: 16V4000 DS2500 and 10V1600
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.

relevance.analysis: EPDs will be asked for by hyperscalers and by UAE and Saudi green building schemes. If a UAE data centre RFP requires EPDs, Cummins Arabia needs Cummins' equivalent documentation ready or it loses on a compliance line rather than on price.

movements.headline: Rolls-Royce reports over 80% Saudisation and 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi fleets ahead of World Defense Show 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce said Saudi nationals are over 80% of its Kingdom workforce, cited 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi naval and government fleets and the 50 high-speed train engines, and named Makeen as its local power solutions joint venture with its own WDS stand.

relevance.analysis: Rolls-Royce is packaging aerospace, naval and mtu activity into one Saudi localisation story, which is how it will approach GAMI, SAMI and PIF-linked buyers of power equipment. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own Saudi headcount, training and local content so procurement teams see a comparable Vision 2030 narrative.

movements.headline: Modular mtu gas engine power plants launched in 10, 20 and 30 MW blocks, 12 to 18 months to grid
movements.summary: Preconfigured, factory-tested 20V4000 L64 modules deliver plants from 5 MW to several hundred MW, hydrogen-ready and biomethane capable, for utilities, data centres and industry. Rolls-Royce cites 17 GW plus of installed gas capacity and 500 mtu gas gensets in the UK.

relevance.analysis: Modular gas blocks with a 12 to 18 month schedule are aimed at exactly the bridging power tenders that Saudi and UAE data centre developers are issuing while grid connections lag. Cummins Arabia's HSK78G offers competitive efficiency but Cummins has not published a comparable pre-engineered block product; Cummins Arabia should build a reference 10 MW HSK78G block design with local balance of plant partners.

movements.headline: FY2025: Power Systems revenue GBP 4.9bn (+19%), margin 17.4%, data centre revenue +35%, order cover 79% for 2026
movements.summary: Power generation revenue grew 30% and data centre revenue 35% in 2025; order intake GBP 6.1bn (+21%), book-to-bill 1.2x. Rolls-Royce guides power generation revenue growth of around 20% a year driven by data centres, doubled US genset capacity, and a next-generation Series 4000 with 20% higher power density launching 2028.

relevance.analysis: mtu is entering 2026 with most of its genset slots sold and margins rising, so it will not chase price in Gulf tenders; it will chase specification and hyperscaler relationships. Cummins Arabia can win on availability and total cost in 2026 but should plan for a more aggressive mtu from 2027 when new capacity frees up.

movements.headline: Al Mulla Power Solutions builds mtu MRO headquarters in Ahmadi, Kuwait, completion September 2026
movements.summary: A 5,000 sqm plot with over 3,600 sqm built-up area in Ahmadi industrial zone will house an MRO centre, workshops, spare parts, technical support, a training centre and offices, built to Rolls-Royce Power Systems standards. The 2024 agreement described stage 4 overhaul capability for four engines simultaneously.

relevance.analysis: Kuwait gets a factory-standard mtu overhaul centre next to KOC's Ahmadi operations for the first time. That closes the service gap that has favoured Cummins Arabia in Kuwait oil sector and government tenders. Cummins Arabia should lock in multi-year service agreements with Kuwait key accounts before the centre opens.

movements.headline: Al Mulla Power Solutions adds Generac as a second genset brand alongside mtu in Kuwait
movements.summary: AMPS signed with Generac Power Systems to distribute diesel, gas and bi-fuel gensets for residential, commercial and industrial customers in Kuwait, with 24/7 after-sales support.

relevance.analysis: Al Mulla is now a multi-brand house covering small Generac sets up to large mtu units, which dilutes focus but also means it will compete across Cummins Arabia's whole Kuwait range. The opportunity is that mtu no longer has a dedicated Kuwait partner; Cummins Arabia can position single-brand accountability with Kuwait government and oil sector buyers.

movements.headline: Mankato logistics centre opens; Series 4000 genset capacity more than doubles by end 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce cut the ribbon on the 250,000 sq ft, USD 24 million Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, stating genset production capacity more than doubles by end of 2026 and that its backup systems support more than 25% of US data centres.

relevance.analysis: Doubled 60 Hz Series 4000 output is the supply side of a future push into Saudi Arabia's 60 Hz data centre market. Lead time, not product, has been mtu's Gulf weakness; from 2027 that argument weakens for Cummins Arabia in KSA.

movements.headline: H1 2026: Power Systems order intake +55% to GBP 4.6bn, power generation revenue +41%, margin 20.3%
movements.summary: Underlying revenue GBP 2,604m (+28% organic), operating profit GBP 528m, book-to-bill 1.8x, OE order cover about 100% for 2026 and over 50% for 2027. Rolls-Royce raised its power generation OE growth outlook to 25% a year through 2030 and cited Series 4000 gas prime power demand in data centres. CFO McCabe cited 50% plus data centre order growth.

relevance.analysis: mtu is sold out for 2026 and half sold for 2027. Any Gulf project needing Series 4000 sets inside 12 months will struggle to get mtu slots, which is a direct window for Cummins Arabia to win on delivery in UAE and KSA data centre and utility tenders through 2027.

why_it_matters.analysis: This is the most mature mtu channel in Cummins Arabia's territory, with a competence centre in ICAD II, a Dubai Maritime City branch, a certified training centre and an award for power generation performance. It is the channel that will carry mtu into UAE data centre and government tenders against Cummins Arabia's UAE branches.

partnerships.scope: Framework licence to manufacture mtu engines and gensets for marine and off-grid power in KSA; exclusive distributor for mobile applications, extended to stationary power across KSA from 2025-10-01; parts, factory-certified MRO, technical support; JV of Saudi Aramco, HD Hyundai Heavy Industries and Dussur

why_it_matters.analysis: An Aramco-linked, PIF-linked (Dussur) owner with a licence to assemble mtu gensets in the Kingdom is the strongest localisation story any genset competitor holds in Saudi Arabia. It gives mtu an IKTVA and Vision 2030 narrative Cummins Arabia must answer with its own local content plan.

partnerships.partner: Al Mulla Power Solutions Co. (AMPS), Al Mulla Group
partnerships.scope: Sole distribution partner for mtu power solutions in Kuwait covering power generation, no-break power, Series 2000 and 4000 engines, ValueCare, reman and overhaul, microgrid and digital, energy storage; MRO centre in Ahmadi due September 2026; also Generac distributor since 2026-07

why_it_matters.analysis: Al Mulla is one of Kuwait's largest trading groups with rental, leasing and automotive reach, and it delivered the Kuwait Airport T2 order within a year of appointment. Its new MRO centre removes mtu's historical service weakness in Kuwait.

partnerships.scope: Listed in the mtu locator as service partner for power generation diesel, oil and gas and marine from a Riyadh address; SDEC's own site lists Mitsubishi generators and Develon, Bobcat and other brands, not mtu

why_it_matters.analysis: SDEC gives mtu a Riyadh service touchpoint but its own marketing does not feature mtu, which suggests a legacy or low-priority relationship. Monitor whether Makeen's new exclusive stationary power mandate displaces it.

partnerships.partner: Limak (Turkey) and Kuwait DGCA / Ministry of Public Works
partnerships.scope: Seven 20V4000 DS3600 gensets for Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works, Limak as main developer

why_it_matters.analysis: Turkish EPCs are prime contractors across Kuwait and Saudi infrastructure. A delivered mtu package with Limak becomes a template for the next airport, hospital or metro depot package.

partnerships.partner: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
partnerships.scope: 12 mtu Kinetic PowerPacks (16V4000 G74S, 1.6 MW each, 19.2 MW) protecting the Shaheen supercomputing and data centre facility, sold direct by Rolls-Royce Solutions Middle East with substantial local content after discussions since 2016

why_it_matters.analysis: KAUST is the reference mtu uses to prove dynamic UPS works in Saudi heat and in a research data centre. Cummins Arabia has no dynamic UPS product, so in tenders that specify DRUPS it needs a static UPS partner or a battery bridging design.

partnerships.scope: Joint position paper on HVO for data centre backup power; Rolls-Royce also states hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years

why_it_matters.analysis: Hyperscaler standards travel to UAE and Saudi campuses. A documented Microsoft collaboration on fuel strategy can shape backup power specifications that favour mtu's HVO-approved range.

partnerships.scope: Five-year guaranteed Series 4000 emergency genset capacity; AVK exclusive mtu integrator for UK and Ireland, over 600 mtu gensets in a decade, HVO-ready data centre focus

why_it_matters.analysis: Shows Rolls-Royce is prepared to ring-fence factory capacity for data centre packagers. If a Gulf packager or hyperscaler obtains a similar guarantee, mtu's delivery position in the region changes overnight.

partnerships.partner: Guangxi Yuchai Machinery (MTU Yuchai Power JV, Suzhou)
partnerships.scope: Chinese production of mtu Series 4000 S83 and Series 2000 (incl. G06) engines for data centres, rental, industrial and oil and gas, including overseas projects

why_it_matters.analysis: A lower-cost mtu engine source that Chinese genset packagers can ship into Gulf rental and construction segments where Cummins Arabia already meets Chinese-packaged Cummins competition.

partnerships.scope: 50 mtu 12V4000 R64 rail engines plus option for 40 for Dammam to Riyadh trains

why_it_matters.analysis: Builds a Series 4000 installed base and service demand in the Eastern Province that Makeen can use to justify parts stock and technicians serving stationary gensets too.

partnerships.scope: 582 MWh and 490 MWh mtu EnergyPack orders; Rolls-Royce states over 1,500 MWh in the Baltics and 200 plus BESS projects worldwide

why_it_matters.analysis: Gives mtu utility-scale BESS references it will cite in Saudi and UAE renewable-plus-storage and microgrid tenders where Cummins Arabia offers gensets and smaller BESS.

competitors.positioning_text: Rehlko is the former Kohler Energy business, majority owned by Platinum Equity since May 2024 and rebranded in September 2024, with Kohler Co. retained as an investment partner. Its large genset play is the in-house KD Series (Liebherr-built engines, 800 kW to 4,500 kVA at 50 Hz and up to 4,000 kW at 60 Hz) built at Brest, France and Changzhou, China, and positioned hard at hyperscale data centres. In KSA, UAE and Kuwait it sells through Midis Group affiliates (MMR in Riyadh, Site & Power and Mideast Data Systems in the UAE, Site and Power Kuwait) plus Abunayyan Trading in Riyadh, supported by an SDMO Industries Middle East office and warehouse in Dubai. Clarke Energy, its gas engine arm, has no Gulf office as of September 2026

movements.headline: Kohler Energy rebrands as Rehlko under Platinum Equity ownership
movements.summary: Platinum Equity completed its acquisition of a majority stake in May 2024 and the business took the Rehlko name on 17 September 2024, with Kohler Co. remaining an investment partner. Portfolio listed as Power Systems, Engines, Uninterruptible Power, Home Energy, Clarke Energy, Curtis Instruments and Heila Technologies, across 100 plus locations.

relevance.analysis: Private equity ownership means Rehlko is being run for growth and exit, with capital allocated to data centre gensets. The Kohler-SDMO brand equity in the Gulf is being migrated to Rehlko, which creates a window where distributor and end-user recognition is weaker. Cummins Arabia should press its brand continuity with consultants and data centre EPCs during this transition.

movements.headline: Rehlko and Liebherr expand KD Series engine partnership
movements.summary: Rehlko announced an expanded partnership with Liebherr for next generation KD Series generators, securing engine supply for the range that competes with Cummins QSK series in the 1 MW to 4 MW band.

relevance.analysis: The KD engine is a Liebherr-derived design, so Rehlko depends on a single external engine partner for its flagship range. Cummins Arabia can position Cummins in-house engine design, manufacturing and Gulf parts stock as a supply certainty argument in tenders.

movements.headline: Rehlko completes acquisition of The Wilmott Group (WB Power Services and Wiltech Acoustics)
movements.summary: UK critical power integrator with 19 UK locations supporting over 4,000 critical power plants joined Rehlko, adding project engineering, acoustic enclosures and lifecycle service to its EMEA data centre offer.

relevance.analysis: Rehlko is building an end-to-end data centre delivery model in EMEA (engineering, enclosures, commissioning, service) rather than selling loose gensets. Gulf hyperscale customers procuring through UK and European consultants will see this offer. Cummins Arabia should be ready to quote full turnkey scope, not equipment only.

movements.headline: Rehlko and Alghanem deliver data centre backup power in Jordan
movements.summary: DCD reported a Jordan data centre backup power project delivered by Rehlko with Alghanem Trading and Contracting, its exclusive Jordan distributor for over 25 years. Capacity and models were not published. The article also states Rehlko ranks third globally in generator manufacturing.

relevance.analysis: This is the closest published Rehlko data centre reference to the Gulf. It shows Rehlko using long-tenured regional distributors for data centre wins in the Levant. The same Midis Group channel that serves Jordan also serves KSA, UAE and Kuwait, so replication in the Gulf is plausible.

movements.headline: Rehlko launches all-new KD Series 60 to 600 kW generators
movements.summary: Rehlko extended the KD brand down into the 60 to 600 kW range, presenting it as a global standard in 80 to 600 kW power and consolidating its industrial lineup under one brand.

relevance.analysis: Below 600 kW is outside the large genset band but this unifies Rehlko's catalogue for distributors, which simplifies their selling and service story in the Gulf. Cummins Arabia's C-series coverage in the same band remains broader, and it should hold price discipline rather than react.

movements.headline: Rehlko and INNIO sign multi-year framework for 1.25 GW of gas engines
movements.summary: Three-year framework agreement allocating 1.25 GW of INNIO gas engine capacity to Rehlko, delivered through Clarke Energy as integrated gas genset plus BESS hybrid solutions for hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data centres and flexible generation in constrained grids, within Clarke Energy's authorised territories.

relevance.analysis: The agreement is confined to Clarke Energy territories, and Clarke Energy lists no office in KSA, UAE or Kuwait. Gulf gas genset demand from data centres and grid constrained sites therefore has no Rehlko gas channel today. Cummins Arabia should push HSK78G and gas genset packages into Gulf data centre and utility bids before Rehlko or another INNIO packager fills that gap.

movements.headline: Rehlko secures another 1.7 GW of hyperscale backup power orders in 60 days
movements.summary: Orders for diesel modular backup generator solutions across multiple North American hyperscale campuses, using repeatable system architectures and standardised delivery models.

relevance.analysis: Rehlko is converting its data centre strategy into gigawatt scale orders and will carry those hyperscaler relationships into the Gulf as the same operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should map which hyperscalers have standardised on Rehlko in North America and pre-empt their Gulf procurement with local stock, 60 Hz KSA references and service coverage.

movements.headline: Rehlko introduces next-generation APM804 control platform
movements.summary: New controller aimed at the complexity, scale and resilience requirements of modern data centres; APM804 now appears as a standard controller option on KD spec sheets.

relevance.analysis: Controls and paralleling are a decision factor for data centre consultants. Cummins Arabia should ensure PowerCommand paralleling and monitoring capabilities are presented head to head with APM804 in consultant briefings.

movements.headline: Rehlko opens Kenosha, Wisconsin assembly for eFRAME enclosures up to 4 MW
movements.summary: New facility for integrated eFRAME enclosures for backup generator solutions up to 4 MW, with plans to expand capacity by more than 400% through the decade; initial production late 2026, full capacity early 2027.

relevance.analysis: Capacity is being added for enclosed 4 MW packages, the format hyperscalers specify. This is North American capacity, so lead time relief for Gulf orders would come from Brest and Changzhou instead. Cummins Arabia should track quoted lead times from Rehlko distributors on 2.5 MW to 4 MW enclosed sets.

movements.headline: Rehlko integrates WB Power Services into its UK and EMEA platform
movements.summary: WB Power Services, acquired August 2025, was integrated into a unified Rehlko EMEA operating model spanning design, installation, testing and service. Lenaik Andrieux named as General Manager EMEA, India and LATAM.

relevance.analysis: The EMEA leadership now runs a standardised delivery model that can be extended to the Middle East through distributors. Cummins Arabia should expect more consistent Rehlko bids on Gulf data centre tenders led by UK and European consultants.

movements.headline: Liebherr expands Colmar engine plant for Rehlko KD Series data centre demand
movements.summary: Ceremony at Liebherr-Components Colmar marked a nearly 12,000 square metre extension; engine production capacity for Rehlko will more than double once fully ramped. Rehlko cited a growing backlog to convert into long-term revenue.

relevance.analysis: Engine supply was the constraint on KD Series volume. Doubling it removes a lead time argument Cummins Arabia could previously use in the 2 MW to 4 MW band. Expect more aggressive KD availability quotes into Gulf data centre projects from 2027.

movements.headline: Rehlko invests EUR 12 million to expand Cholet, France switchgear plant
movements.summary: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.

relevance.analysis: Rehlko is shortening lead times on the paralleling switchgear that ships with large genset packages to EMEA including the Gulf. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own switchgear lead times and partner capacity so it is not outpaced on complete package delivery.

movements.headline: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
movements.summary: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.

relevance.analysis: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.

partnerships.partner: Midis Group (MMR KSA, MDS Site & Power UAE, Mideast Data Systems, Site and Power Kuwait)
partnerships.scope: Kohler-SDMO / Rehlko industrial genset distribution, installation and service; MDS Energy describes exclusive partnership with Kohler and Vertiv; MDS SI Group has 2,600 plus staff and 60 affiliates across the Middle East and Turkey

why_it_matters.analysis: Midis bundles Rehlko gensets with Vertiv UPS and cooling in one data centre proposal across all three Cummins Arabia countries. That single-vendor site package is attractive to colocation and telecom customers (Mobily, Ooredoo, Omantel are listed references). Cummins Arabia should build equivalent alliances with UPS and cooling vendors or partner with data centre integrators to neutralise the bundle.

partnerships.scope: Authorised distributor for industrial gensets, service and parts in Saudi Arabia per Rehlko EMEA locator

why_it_matters.analysis: A second Saudi channel gives Rehlko reach into Abunayyan Group's utility, water and industrial customer base. Cummins Arabia should watch for KD Series offers in SEC and water sector tenders where Abunayyan has relationships.

partnerships.scope: Supplies KD Series engines; Colmar plant extension of nearly 12,000 square metres will more than double capacity for Rehlko

why_it_matters.analysis: Removes the engine supply ceiling on KD Series. Cummins Arabia loses a lead time advantage in the 2 MW to 4 MW data centre band from 2027 onward.

partnerships.scope: 1.25 GW of gas engines over three years, delivered via Clarke Energy in its authorised territories, for data centre and flexible generation hybrids with BESS

why_it_matters.analysis: Clarke Energy has no Gulf territory, so this gas capacity does not reach KSA, UAE or Kuwait through Rehlko. Cummins Arabia can lead on gas gensets for Gulf data centres and industrial CHP while that channel gap exists.

partnerships.scope: S16R and S16R2 engines in Kohler-SDMO T Series (T1650, T2200C, T2500-E) still listed in the Rehlko EMEA catalogue

why_it_matters.analysis: Rehlko still offers Mitsubishi-engined 1.6 MVA to 2.5 MVA sets in EMEA alongside KD Series, which means Gulf buyers may meet the same S16R engine under two competitor brands. Cummins Arabia should differentiate on Cummins engine service network rather than engine to engine specs.

partnerships.scope: Exclusive Rehlko distributor in Jordan for over 25 years; delivered data centre backup power project in 2025

why_it_matters.analysis: Levant reference for Rehlko data centre delivery. Not in Cummins Arabia's territory, but Jordanian data centre operators and consultants also work in KSA.

competitors.positioning_text: MHIET is the MHI engine subsidiary behind the Mitsubishi Generator Series. MGS sets use MHIET's own S-series engines (S12R, S16R, S16R2) at 1500 or 1800 rpm and are assembled by MHI Engine System Asia in Singapore, Vietnam and, since 2025, Johor Bahru, with a dedicated MGS-DC rating table for data centres. movements.headline: MHIET launches MGS3100R, a 3,000 kVA class set with common rail S16R2 engine
movements.summary: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.

relevance.analysis: This is Mitsubishi's answer to the 2.5 MW to 3 MW data centre node that Cummins serves with QSK78 and QSK95 based sets. It is not yet on the Middle East catalogue, which caps Mitsubishi's Gulf offer at 2,750 kVA until MHIES-ME adopts MGS-R. Cummins Arabia should keep quoting above 2.75 MVA where Mitsubishi cannot follow locally.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA adds MGS assembly plant in Johor Bahru, Malaysia with WDG Assembly
movements.summary: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.

relevance.analysis: Extra MGS capacity in Asia shortens lead times for Gulf orders that ship from Singapore. Cummins Arabia should expect Mitsubishi dealers in KSA and UAE to quote firmer delivery on 1.5 MVA to 2.75 MVA sets.

movements.headline: MHIET launches 450 kW gas cogeneration system capable of hydrogen co-firing
movements.summary: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.

relevance.analysis: Small gas CHP is a Japan-first product. Gulf relevance is limited today but it signals Mitsubishi will pitch hydrogen-ready gas engines into Saudi and UAE decarbonisation programmes where Cummins gas gensets also compete.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA launches containerised MGS2500R for data centres
movements.summary: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.

relevance.analysis: A plug-in containerised 2.5 MVA set is the format UAE and Kuwait colocation builders ask for. Cummins Arabia should have a matching containerised C2500 or C2750 offer priced and documented for 50 Hz markets before Mitsubishi dealers bring this to Dubai.

movements.headline: Mitsubishi Power unveils first locally assembled M501JAC gas turbine at Dammam, marking 60 years in Saudi Arabia
movements.summary: The Dammam facility assembled its first JAC turbine, destined for the 475 MW Amiral cogeneration plant in Jubail (TAQA and JERA) serving SATORP. Mitsubishi Power reports over 50% Saudisation and partnerships with Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC.

relevance.analysis: Mitsubishi Power's Saudi localisation is in gas turbines, not gensets, but it gives the Mitsubishi name Vision 2030 credibility with Aramco, SEC and the Eastern Province. If MHIET ever routes MGS assembly or service through Dammam, that would be a direct challenge. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Saudi localisation and IKTVA content visible to the same buyers.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA terminates Indonesia dealership for MGS-G gas generator sets
movements.summary: Formal termination notice for the MGS-G dealership arrangement in Indonesia.

relevance.analysis: Shows Mitsubishi actively manages its gas genset channel. In the Middle East MGS-G is sold direct by MHIES-ME with no local dealer, so gas genset coverage in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is thin. Cummins Arabia's gas offer faces little Mitsubishi channel pressure.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA hosts MGS Sales and Service Maintenance Conference 2026 for Asia Pacific dealers in Bali
movements.summary: Dealer network conference under the theme 'Preserving Excellence. Engineered, Not Accidental'; Diamond Dealer awards to Malaysian, Indonesian and Hong Kong dealers. Middle East dealers were not referenced.

relevance.analysis: Mitsubishi's dealer development effort is centred on Asia Pacific; the Middle East network is small (one dealer per Gulf country) and run from Sharjah. Cummins Arabia's branch depth in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is a clear service argument against MGS in tenders that score after-sales coverage.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA headline partner at DCD Connect APAC 2026, pitching MGS-R and grid-to-chip resilience
movements.summary: MHI-ESA presented MGS-R innovations and one-stop data centre solutions for AI and HPC workloads in Bali.

relevance.analysis: Mitsubishi is marketing MGS as an AI data centre product in Asia. The same hyperscale and colocation operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should track which APAC operators standardise on MGS and prepare Gulf-specific counters.

movements.headline: MHIET 500 kW class 100% hydrogen engine generator set reaches commercial readiness level
movements.summary: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.

relevance.analysis: Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.

movements.headline: Mitsubishi Power wins boiler supply for heavy oil to gas fuel conversion at Jeddah South and Shuqaiq plants
movements.summary: Contract from Saudi Energy for dual fuel conversion of four units at each of two 2.9 GW west coast plants, with Dar Al Balad as local EPC and Mitsubishi Corporation Machinery as agent.

relevance.analysis: Context only: it deepens Mitsubishi's standing with Saudi utility buyers and local EPCs. No genset scope. Cummins Arabia should note that Dar Al Balad and similar EPCs now have a working Mitsubishi relationship that could extend to backup power packages.

movements.headline: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
movements.summary: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.

relevance.analysis: KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.

why_it_matters.analysis: SDEC is an established Saudi packager with an Eastern Province factory and nationwide offices, so MGS in KSA comes with a credible local assembly and service story. It also carries other engine brands, so its loyalty to Mitsubishi is commercial rather than exclusive. Cummins Arabia should watch SDEC in Aramco and industrial 60 Hz tenders and use its own Saudi branch coverage and parts stock to compete.

competitors.positioning_text: Weichai is the Chinese OEM with the fastest growing large genset engine business: 2025 data centre backup power sales rose 259 percent, M-series large-bore engines passed 10,000 units, and H1 2026 data centre genset sales (over 1,400 units) already beat full-year 2025. Baudouin is the French brand it uses for the Gulf, selling PowerKit engines to local packagers (Almajd Power in Jeddah, Galadari Energy Solutions in Dubai) and, since October 2024, complete data centre gensets from 2,000 to 6,250 kVA with Uptime Institute pre-approved ratings, 50 degree C cooling packages and a marketing pitch built on lead time rather than brand. Baudouin has been a platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy in Dubai (seventh participation in 2025), exhibits at Data Center Nation Riyadh, and its M55 engines now also arrive in the region inside Generac's 2.25 to 3.25 MW data centre sets. Weichai Middle East FZE operates from Jebel Ali as a power generator supplier

movements.headline: Baudouin launches complete generator sets for data centres, 2,000 to 5,250 kVA (baseline)
movements.summary: Baudouin moved from engines only to complete M33 and M55 gensets for data centres with Uptime Institute pre-approved units and announced the 20M55 genset (4,250 to 5,250 kVA). Manufacturing sites listed in India, China, Russia, Italy, Germany, France and the US.

relevance.analysis: This is the structural change: Baudouin now bids as a single-brand genset supplier, not just an engine to local packagers, and it targets the same hyperscale and colocation buyers Cummins Arabia courts in Riyadh, Dammam, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Cummins Arabia should expect Baudouin gensets in consultant shortlists from 2025 onward.

movements.headline: Baudouin exhibits at Data Center Nation Riyadh with 2,000 to 5,250 kVA M33 and M55 gensets
movements.summary: Baudouin presented its data centre genset range and previewed the 20M55 to Saudi operators and developers, citing Uptime Institute pre-approval and ISO 8528 G3 load acceptance.

relevance.analysis: Direct marketing into the Saudi data centre pipeline. Cummins Arabia should make sure Saudi data centre consultants and EPCs have Cummins DCC ratings, 60 Hz performance data and local service commitments in hand before Baudouin's lead-time pitch lands.

movements.headline: Baudouin platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy 2025: 20M61 genset (6,250 kVA) pre-launch, 6M31 Stage V PowerKit, 20M55 gas genset
movements.summary: At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V. CEO Fabrizio Mozzi called it the largest genset available for critical backup power. Baudouin claimed best lead times in the market.

relevance.analysis: A 6,250 kVA single unit outranks Cummins' largest diesel node and is aimed at hyperscale campuses in the UAE and KSA. Cummins Arabia's counter is the installed base, Cummins factory paralleling and controls, service depth and proven 50 degree C performance. It should also test Baudouin's lead-time claims against real Cummins slot availability when quoting.

movements.headline: Baudouin publishes November 2025 data centre genset rating cards (50 and 60 Hz) covering WPG1900 to WPG5775
movements.summary: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.

relevance.analysis: The 60 Hz card matters for Saudi Arabia: Baudouin now publishes DCR and DCP ratings at 1800 rpm including 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, which is what Saudi data centre specifications ask for. Cummins Arabia should benchmark its 60 Hz C2500 to C3500 DCC offers against the WPG2500B76 to WPG4000B76 band.

movements.headline: Weichai 2025 results: data centre backup power sales up 259 percent, M-series engines pass 10,000 units, 20M61 5 MW engine launched
movements.summary: Weichai Power reported 2025 revenue of RMB 231.8 billion. Data centre backup power product sales rose 259 percent; M-series large-bore engine sales exceeded 10,000 units (up 32 percent) with revenue up 65 percent. It launched the 20M61, described as the world's first 5 MW high-speed diesel generator engine, and PSI (US) derived 81 percent of revenue from power generation.

relevance.analysis: Weichai now has the volume and cash flow to price aggressively in export markets and to fund Baudouin's Gulf marketing. Growth of this scale in one year also means Weichai capacity is real, which supports the lead-time argument used against Cummins in Gulf tenders.

movements.headline: Baudouin positions 1,900 to 6,250 kVA range for hyperscale campuses and pushes lead time as the decisive variable

relevance.analysis: This is the sales script Cummins Arabia will meet in Gulf data centre bids: a bigger single unit and a shorter delivery slot. Cummins Arabia needs firm factory slot commitments in its proposals and should quantify Cummins' service network and parts stock in KSA and UAE against Baudouin's thin local footprint.

movements.headline: Baudouin partners with EODev on solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) power, commercial launch September 2026
movements.summary: EODev will roll out Baudouin SOFC continuous baseload power across Europe with exclusive rights in France and Poland. Weichai's SOFC system holds EU CE certification with over 65 percent electrical efficiency and Weichai deepened its Ceres Power collaboration in November 2025.

relevance.analysis: Europe only for now, but SOFC baseload for data centres is the kind of grid-independent offer Gulf hyperscalers will ask about as grid connection queues lengthen. Cummins Arabia should track whether Baudouin brings SOFC to Middle East Energy 2027.

movements.headline: Weichai H1 2026: data centre genset sales above 1,400 units, more than all of 2025
movements.summary: Weichai reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 123.16 billion (up 8.8 percent) and net profit of RMB 7.7 billion (up 36.5 percent). Data centre generator sales exceeded 1,400 units in the half, surpassing full-year 2025, with M-series high-power engines at 6,700 units (up 31.5 percent). Baudouin signed a strategic cooperation with a major French customer.

relevance.analysis: Run-rate of roughly 2,800 data centre gensets a year puts Weichai among the largest volume producers of data centre sets worldwide. Gulf hyperscalers that buy globally will see Weichai and Baudouin on approved vendor lists, which erodes the reference advantage Cummins holds in the region.

movements.headline: Generac's Baudouin M55 based 2.25 to 3.25 MW data centre sets gain a global hyperscale supply agreement covering the Middle East
movements.summary: Generac's SDMD2250, SDMD2500 (12M55, 65.6 L) and SDMD3250 (16M55, 87.5 L) diesel sets use Baudouin M55 engines with Marathon DataMAX alternators and DSE G8601 controls. Generac signed a global supply agreement with a hyperscale operator naming APAC, Europe, Middle East and Latin America.

relevance.analysis: Baudouin engines reach the Gulf through two brands at once: Baudouin's own WPG sets and Generac's SDMD sets. In a hyperscale programme awarded globally, Cummins Arabia can lose Saudi or UAE sites without ever seeing a local tender. It should work with Cummins Inc. on global account coverage rather than rely on local bids alone.

movements.headline: Baudouin joins the Gulf Data Centre Association (GCDA) alongside Italian and Spanish data centre associations (baseline)
movements.summary: Baudouin announced collaborations with GCDA (covering Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE), IDA (Italy) and SPAIN DC, promoting M Series engines 25 to 4,150 kVA with cooling above 50 degree C ambient and HVO testing.

relevance.analysis: GCDA membership gives Baudouin a seat in the Gulf data centre community and its events. Cummins Arabia should confirm its own visibility in GCDA programmes so Baudouin does not become the default OEM voice there.

movements.headline: Yuchai (China Yuchai International, Singapore HQ, NYSE CYD) is the second Chinese engine OEM whose genset engines appear in low-cost Gulf packages
movements.summary: China Yuchai International, through Guangxi Yuchai Machinery, produces engines for generator sets alongside marine and industrial engines. No verified 2025 to 2026 Gulf distributor announcement, Gulf project or data centre product from Yuchai was found in this research.

relevance.analysis: Yuchai-powered sets from Chinese packagers compete at the low end of Gulf tenders (typically below 1,000 kVA). Cummins Arabia's exposure is in price-led utility, telecom and construction bids in KSA and Kuwait rather than in data centres. Track Chinese packager registrations on Etimad and CAPT rather than Yuchai itself.
