competitors.name: Perkins / FG Wilson
competitors.legal_name: Perkins Engines Company Limited (Peterborough, UK) and FG Wilson, trading as Caterpillar (NI) Ltd (Belfast/Larne, UK); both wholly owned by Caterpillar Inc.
brands: Marapco (Jubaili Bros gensets on Perkins engines)
competitors.hq: Perkins: Eastfield, Peterborough, England. FG Wilson: Belfast/Larne, Northern Ireland. Parent Caterpillar Inc.: Irving, Texas, USA
competitors.founded_note: Perkins founded 1932 (Frank Perkins and Charles Chapman), acquired by Caterpillar in 1998 for US$1.325 billion. FG Wilson founded 1966 in Belfast; celebrated 60 years at Catalyst 2026.
competitors.employees: Not disclosed separately for Perkins or FG Wilson. Caterpillar Inc. group: about 118,000 (2025). FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE Dubai: over 140 staff (company directory listing)
competitors.revenue: Not disclosed separately. Caterpillar Inc. group sales and revenues US$67.6 billion (2025)
competitors.sector: Diesel engines for electric power (Perkins, 4 to 2,500 kVA node engines) and packaged diesel generator sets (FG Wilson, 6.8 to 2,500 kVA)
competitors.positioning_text: Perkins sells engines to independent genset packagers and FG Wilson sells complete gensets, so the two Caterpillar brands reach Gulf buyers through channels that are separate from the Cat dealer network. In KSA and UAE the Perkins channel runs through Kanoo Machinery and its Dubai arm Power Systems Gulf, while the FG Wilson channel runs through Zahid Group's TAMGO in Saudi Arabia and the TAMGO-owned FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE in Jebel Ali. Perkins engines also enter the market inside Jubaili Bros, Teksan, Almajd Power and Generac packaged sets, which multiplies the brand's presence in the 500 to 2,500 kVA band where Cummins Arabia competes. The current product push is the electronic 5000 Series (5006 to 5016, 750 to 2,500 kVA) aimed at data centres and hospitals, plus HVO and B100 fuel flexibility

movements.headline: Perkins brings new 2606 (13 L) and 5012 (46 L) engines to Middle East Energy 2025 in Dubai
movements.summary: Perkins showcased the 2606 (350 to 550 kVA at 50 Hz, available H2 2025, 1,000 hour service intervals, HVO and B100 capable) and the electronic 5012 (1,275 to 1,875 kVA at 50 Hz, 1,125 to 1,500 kWe at 60 Hz, ISO G3, NFPA110, EPA Tier 2 on 60 Hz). Applications cited: data centres, hospitals, power plants.

relevance.analysis: The 5012 sits exactly on the 1,250 to 1,875 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSK50 and QSK60 based sets into data centres and hospitals, and it is offered to every independent packager in the Gulf. The 2606 attacks the 350 to 550 kVA band with 1,000 hour service intervals. Cummins Arabia should benchmark total cost of ownership against 5012-powered Jubaili and Teksan sets and lead with factory-packaged reliability, local service coverage and 50 degree C ambient performance.

movements.headline: Perkins shows 2600 Series, hydrogen hybrid IOPU and battery-electric power unit at CONEXPO 2026
movements.summary: Perkins announced the 904J-E36TTA (129 kW), the 13 litre 2600 Series (340 to 515 kW, Stage V and Tier 4 Final), Project Coeus hydrogen hybrid IOPU (379 kW combined) and a 95.5 kW battery-electric power unit. Richard Hemmings, VP and GM Global Sales, Marketing, Service and Parts, framed the message as lower total cost of ownership and future fuel readiness.

relevance.analysis: Hybrid and alternative fuel work is still at prototype stage for Perkins and is aimed at off-highway more than gensets. The relevant signal is the Stage V 2600 Series, which packagers can pair with Gulf tenders that start asking for Stage V or Tier 4 Final in urban and data centre sites. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Stage V and Tier 4 Final genset offer visible to consultants in UAE and KSA.

movements.headline: FG Wilson gensets pass HVO field trials with Tria Energy
movements.summary: FG Wilson Engineering (Dublin) Ltd and Tria Energy reported diesel-equivalent performance on HVO (EN 15940) across load conditions with no engine or fuel system changes, up to 90 percent lifecycle CO2 savings, aimed at data centre, construction and critical infrastructure customers.

relevance.analysis: HVO acceptance is becoming a standard question in data centre tenders in the UAE. FG Wilson now has published trial evidence to cite. Cummins Arabia should have equivalent HVO approval statements for its data centre range ready in tender documents.

movements.headline: FG Wilson Catalyst 2026: 60th anniversary global dealer conference in Belfast
movements.summary: FG Wilson gathered its global dealer network, customers and staff in Belfast's Titanic Quarter for a week of strategy, innovation and growth sessions and a Product Discovery Zone. No new product launches were announced.

relevance.analysis: A dealer conference of this scale signals a channel re-energising exercise. Expect dealer targets and campaign activity in the Gulf over the next 12 months, especially from FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE and TAMGO. Cummins Arabia should expect sharper FG Wilson pricing in the 500 to 1,500 kVA commercial band.

movements.headline: FG Wilson appoints Roger Kennedy as General Manager
movements.summary: Roger Kennedy, a 30 year FG Wilson veteran with a commercial background, was appointed General Manager to lead the FG Wilson team worldwide.

relevance.analysis: A commercially oriented GM tends to prioritise dealer growth and volume. Combined with the Catalyst 2026 conference, this points to a growth push rather than a hold strategy for FG Wilson.

movements.headline: FG Wilson lists new 'M' variants across the large range (P1100-1M to P2500-3M) with DSE7410 control
movements.summary: FG Wilson's large range pages now pair each legacy model with an M variant (P1100-1M, P1650-1M, P2250-3M, P2500-3M), all on Perkins 4008, 4012 and 4016 engines, FG Wilson alternators with AREP excitation and Deep Sea 7410 controllers, with new datasheets dated 2024-10 and 2026-03.

relevance.analysis: FG Wilson's top end remains 2,500 kVA on the mechanical 4016-61TRG3 while the electronic 5016 is sold to other packagers. Cummins Arabia's C2500 to C3500 range and its factory data centre ratings remain a differentiator above 2,500 kVA and in DCC rated applications. Below 2,500 kVA expect the refreshed FG Wilson range to be pushed hard by TAMGO and FG Wilson FZE.

movements.headline: Generac standardises 1,000 to 1,500 kW US industrial diesel sets on Perkins 4008 (30.6 L) and 4012/D46L (45.8 L) engines
movements.summary: Generac's SD1000/MD1000 use the Perkins 30.6 L 8 cylinder engine and the SD1250/MD1250 (1,250 and 1,500 kW nodes) use the Perkins D46L 12 cylinder engine with Deep Sea G8601 controllers.

relevance.analysis: Perkins gains a large 60 Hz OEM volume base through Generac, which feeds 60 Hz product maturity relevant to Saudi Arabia. If Generac's Gulf dealers (Atlas Power Solutions, Watan Altaqa, Al Mulla) bring these sets to KSA, Cummins Arabia faces Perkins-powered 1,000 to 1,500 kW packages under a second brand.

movements.headline: Jubaili Bros (Perkins packager) signs strategic partnership with Wholesale Electric Asia for oil and gas power packages
movements.summary: Jubaili Bros (1,600 employees, 11 countries, 3 manufacturing plants, 1.5 GW annual capacity) and Singapore based WEA agreed to cooperate on power generation distribution and customised oil and gas packages across the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia.

relevance.analysis: Jubaili Bros is scaling as a regional packager and now targets oil and gas packages, a core Cummins Arabia segment in KSA and Kuwait. Its Perkins-based JP range runs to 2,250 kVA prime. Cummins Arabia should monitor Jubaili's Saudi factory ramp and its bids into Aramco contractor and rental fleets.

movements.headline: Jubaili Bros adds MWM gas gensets (400 to 4,500 kW) for Middle East and Africa
movements.summary: MWM (Mannheim) and Jubaili Bros (Dubai) announced a partnership to offer MWM gas generators of 400 to 4,500 kW electrical across MEA, under Group CEO Dr Marcus Schumacher.

relevance.analysis: This is context for the Perkins channel: Jubaili now covers diesel (Perkins) and gas (MWM), which lets it bid full gas and diesel packages against Cummins Arabia's HSK78G and diesel range. Included as a late 2024 baseline because it shapes 2025 to 2026 bidding behaviour.

why_it_matters.analysis: Kanoo gives Perkins a parts and service backbone in Dammam, Riyadh, Jeddah, Jubail and Yanbu that packagers lean on when they bid against Cummins Arabia. Cummins Arabia should target the mid band (500 to 2,000 kVA) with the Cummins single-brand argument and Olayan's local presence, and pre-qualify early with EPCs such as Samsung Engineering.

partnerships.scope: Lebanese-origin packager (1,600 employees, 11 countries, 3 manufacturing plants, 1.5 GW annual capacity) building JP and Marapco gensets 9 to over 2,000 kVA on Perkins engines including the 5012; historic FG Wilson dealer 1982 to 2009; new Saudi manufacturing; MWM gas partnership

why_it_matters.analysis: Jubaili is the volume packager that turns Perkins engines into low-cost sets in exactly Cummins Arabia's UAE and KSA territory, now with Saudi assembly. Its JP2250/50 (2,250 kVA prime) reaches the top of the Perkins range. Cummins Arabia should track Jubaili's Saudi plant ramp, its telecom fleet wins, and defend with factory-built quality, data centre ratings and Cummins-backed warranty.

why_it_matters.analysis: Turkish packagers on Perkins engines undercut on price in Saudi rental and oilfield camp power. Cummins Arabia should keep rental fleet owners such as Bin Quaraya close and offer fleet service agreements that imported sets cannot match.

movements.headline: Generac signs global supply agreement with a hyperscale data centre operator covering APAC, Europe, Middle East and Latin America

signals.headline: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
signals.summary: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.
signals.analysis: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.

signals.headline: Weichai H1 2026: data centre genset sales above 1,400 units, more than all of 2025
signals.summary: Weichai reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 123.16 billion (up 8.8 percent) and net profit of RMB 7.7 billion (up 36.5 percent). Data centre generator sales exceeded 1,400 units in the half, surpassing full-year 2025, with M-series high-power engines at 6,700 units (up 31.5 percent). Baudouin signed a strategic cooperation with a major French customer.
signals.analysis: Run-rate of roughly 2,800 data centre gensets a year puts Weichai among the largest volume producers of data centre sets worldwide. Gulf hyperscalers that buy globally will see Weichai and Baudouin on approved vendor lists, which erodes the reference advantage Cummins holds in the region.

signals.headline: Q2 2026: first USD 20 billion quarter, power generation +72%, backlog USD 72 billion, 10 MW medium-speed gas engine production restarted for 1.5 GW
signals.summary: Sales USD 20.5 billion (+24%), Power & Energy USD 8.2 billion (+17%) with 24.6% margin, power generation retail sales +72% on large gensets and turbines for data centres, backlog USD 72 billion (+92%), 2026 guidance raised to mid to high teens growth, USD 392 million IEEPA tariff recovery booked, and production of a 10 MW medium-speed gas engine restarted with shipments from Q4 2026 targeting 1.5 GW.
signals.analysis: The 10 MW medium-speed gas platform fills the gap between Cat high-speed gensets and Solar turbines, directly bracketing Cummins HSK78G and QSK95 gas offers for Gulf industrial and utility prime power. Cummins Arabia should expect Cat to bid gas plants at 10 to 100 MW in Saudi and Kuwait with a single-OEM stack by 2027.

signals.headline: Baudouin positions 1,900 to 6,250 kVA range for hyperscale campuses and pushes lead time as the decisive variable
signals.analysis: This is the sales script Cummins Arabia will meet in Gulf data centre bids: a bigger single unit and a shorter delivery slot. Cummins Arabia needs firm factory slot commitments in its proposals and should quantify Cummins' service network and parts stock in KSA and UAE against Baudouin's thin local footprint.

signals.headline: Liebherr expands Colmar engine plant for Rehlko KD Series data centre demand
signals.summary: Ceremony at Liebherr-Components Colmar marked a nearly 12,000 square metre extension; engine production capacity for Rehlko will more than double once fully ramped. Rehlko cited a growing backlog to convert into long-term revenue.
signals.analysis: Engine supply was the constraint on KD Series volume. Doubling it removes a lead time argument Cummins Arabia could previously use in the 2 MW to 4 MW band. Expect more aggressive KD availability quotes into Gulf data centre projects from 2027.

signals.headline: Generac's Baudouin M55 based 2.25 to 3.25 MW data centre sets gain a global hyperscale supply agreement covering the Middle East
signals.summary: Generac's SDMD2250, SDMD2500 (12M55, 65.6 L) and SDMD3250 (16M55, 87.5 L) diesel sets use Baudouin M55 engines with Marathon DataMAX alternators and DSE G8601 controls. Generac signed a global supply agreement with a hyperscale operator naming APAC, Europe, Middle East and Latin America.

In a hyperscale programme awarded globally, Cummins Arabia can lose Saudi or UAE sites without ever seeing a local tender. It should work with Cummins Inc. on global account coverage rather than rely on local bids alone.

Cummins Arabia should coordinate with Cummins Inc. global hyperscale account teams to defend Saudi and UAE campuses and make sure local service capability is part of the global pitch.

signals.headline: Q1 2026: Caterpillar triples large reciprocating engine capacity plan to about 3x 2024 levels, adds about 15 GW per year, power generation +48%
signals.summary: Q1 2026 sales USD 17.4 billion (+22%), Power & Energy USD 7 billion (+22%), power generation sales +48%; large engine capacity plan raised from 2x to nearly 3x 2024 levels with investment mainly 2027 to 2029, about 15 GW of additional annual capacity; large engine backlog up 3.5x since January 2024; tariff cost guidance cut to USD 2.2 to 2.4 billion; six agreements of at least 1 GW each announced; EAME outlook noted softening anticipated in the Middle East.
signals.analysis: This is the structural threat. By 2028 Cat will have far more 3500, C175 and G3500 engine supply than today and will need non-US outlets for it, and the Gulf is the obvious one. Cummins Arabia should lock multi-year supply agreements and service contracts with key Saudi and UAE accounts in 2026 and 2027 while Cat is still capacity constrained.

signals.headline: Rehlko secures another 1.7 GW of hyperscale backup power orders in 60 days
signals.summary: Orders for diesel modular backup generator solutions across multiple North American hyperscale campuses, using repeatable system architectures and standardised delivery models.
signals.analysis: Rehlko is converting its data centre strategy into gigawatt scale orders and will carry those hyperscaler relationships into the Gulf as the same operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should map which hyperscalers have standardised on Rehlko in North America and pre-empt their Gulf procurement with local stock, 60 Hz KSA references and service coverage.

signals.headline: Weichai 2025 results: data centre backup power sales up 259 percent, M-series engines pass 10,000 units, 20M61 5 MW engine launched
signals.summary: Weichai Power reported 2025 revenue of RMB 231.8 billion. Data centre backup power product sales rose 259 percent; M-series large-bore engine sales exceeded 10,000 units (up 32 percent) with revenue up 65 percent. It launched the 20M61, described as the world's first 5 MW high-speed diesel generator engine, and PSI (US) derived 81 percent of revenue from power generation.
signals.analysis: Weichai now has the volume and cash flow to price aggressively in export markets and to fund Baudouin's Gulf marketing. Growth of this scale in one year also means Weichai capacity is real, which supports the lead-time argument used against Cummins in Gulf tenders.

signals.headline: Al Mulla Power Solutions builds mtu MRO headquarters in Ahmadi, Kuwait, completion September 2026
signals.summary: A 5,000 sqm plot with over 3,600 sqm built-up area in Ahmadi industrial zone will house an MRO centre, workshops, spare parts, technical support, a training centre and offices, built to Rolls-Royce Power Systems standards. The 2024 agreement described stage 4 overhaul capability for four engines simultaneously.
signals.analysis: Kuwait gets a factory-standard mtu overhaul centre next to KOC's Ahmadi operations for the first time. That closes the service gap that has favoured Cummins Arabia in Kuwait oil sector and government tenders. Cummins Arabia should lock in multi-year service agreements with Kuwait key accounts before the centre opens.

signals.headline: Modular mtu gas engine power plants launched in 10, 20 and 30 MW blocks, 12 to 18 months to grid
signals.summary: Preconfigured, factory-tested 20V4000 L64 modules deliver plants from 5 MW to several hundred MW, hydrogen-ready and biomethane capable, for utilities, data centres and industry. Rolls-Royce cites 17 GW plus of installed gas capacity and 500 mtu gas gensets in the UK.
signals.analysis: Modular gas blocks with a 12 to 18 month schedule are aimed at exactly the bridging power tenders that Saudi and UAE data centre developers are issuing while grid connections lag. Cummins Arabia's HSK78G offers competitive efficiency but Cummins has not published a comparable pre-engineered block product; Cummins Arabia should build a reference 10 MW HSK78G block design with local balance of plant partners.

signals.headline: FY2025 results: Power Generation above USD 10 billion (+30%), Q4 power generation +44%, Middle East called out as strong, 2026 tariff cost USD 2.6 billion, price realisation about +2%
signals.summary: Q4 2025 Power & Energy sales USD 9.4 billion (+23%), profit USD 1.841 billion; CEO said Power Generation exceeded USD 10 billion in 2025 with growth above 30% and that the Middle East continues to be really strong; 2026 tariff cost guided at about USD 2.6 billion with roughly 2% favourable price realisation for the year.
signals.analysis: Cat leadership sees the Middle East as a strong market entering 2026 and is pushing price up about 2% while absorbing tariffs. Cummins Arabia has a pricing window on US-built product costs; it should quantify landed cost differences per node and sell that to Saudi and UAE buyers before Cat mitigates.

signals.headline: Seven mtu 20V4000 DS3600 gensets for Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2
signals.summary: Rolls-Royce is supplying seven 20-cylinder Series 4000 DS3600 backup gensets through local partner Al Mulla Power Systems for the Limak-built Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works. Units are specified for 55 C ambient, delivery early 2026 then commissioning.
signals.analysis: This is mtu's first public Kuwait win through the new Al Mulla channel and it lands in the 3 MVA class where Cummins Arabia sells C3000 and C3500 class sets. A government airport reference plus a Turkish EPC relationship (Limak) gives mtu credibility for the next Kuwait infrastructure packages. Cummins Arabia should map Limak and other Turkish EPC procurement teams active in Kuwait and KSA.

signals.headline: Baudouin publishes November 2025 data centre genset rating cards (50 and 60 Hz) covering WPG1900 to WPG5775
signals.summary: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.
signals.analysis: The 60 Hz card matters for Saudi Arabia: Baudouin now publishes DCR and DCP ratings at 1800 rpm including 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, which is what Saudi data centre specifications ask for. Cummins Arabia should benchmark its 60 Hz C2500 to C3500 DCC offers against the WPG2500B76 to WPG4000B76 band.

signals.headline: Caterpillar commits USD 725 million to expand Lafayette large engine plant for 3500 series power generation engines
signals.summary: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.
signals.analysis: The 3512 and 3516 are the engines behind the gensets Cummins Arabia meets most often in Gulf tenders. More 3500 capacity shortens Cat lead times from 2027, which removes one of the few advantages Cummins has held while Cat allocated engines to US hyperscalers.

signals.headline: Makeen becomes exclusive mtu distributor for stationary power across Saudi Arabia
signals.summary: Effective 2025-10-01, Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen) extended its exclusive mtu distributorship from mobile applications to stationary power across the Kingdom, covering genuine parts, factory-certified MRO and integrated power solutions.
signals.analysis: For the first time mtu gensets have an exclusive Saudi channel owned by Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur, with a localisation licence behind it. That combination speaks directly to Aramco, SEC, NEOM and IKTVA-scored buyers that Cummins Arabia sells to. Cummins Arabia's answer is installed base, 60 Hz stock and its own local content record; it should expect Makeen to appear in Eastern Province industrial and data centre tenders within 12 months.

signals.headline: Fast-start mtu 20V4000 gas gensets for data centre prime and backup power, 45 second start from 2026
signals.summary: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.
signals.analysis: This targets the same grid-constrained data centre prime power need that Cummins addresses with the HSK78G and QSK95 gas sets, and the 60 Hz variant is built for markets like Saudi Arabia. In UAE and KSA data centre campuses where gas is available, mtu can now bid diesel backup, gas prime and dynamic UPS as one package. Cummins Arabia should lead with HSK78G efficiency and Cummins' Gulf gas service record before mtu's 60 Hz set ships.

signals.headline: Baudouin platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy 2025: 20M61 genset (6,250 kVA) pre-launch, 6M31 Stage V PowerKit, 20M55 gas genset
signals.summary: At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V. CEO Fabrizio Mozzi called it the largest genset available for critical backup power. Baudouin claimed best lead times in the market.
signals.analysis: A 6,250 kVA single unit outranks Cummins' largest diesel node and is aimed at hyperscale campuses in the UAE and KSA. Cummins Arabia's counter is the installed base, Cummins factory paralleling and controls, service depth and proven 50 degree C performance. It should also test Baudouin's lead-time claims against real Cummins slot availability when quoting.

signals.headline: Perkins brings new 2606 (13 L) and 5012 (46 L) engines to Middle East Energy 2025 in Dubai
signals.summary: Perkins showcased the 2606 (350 to 550 kVA at 50 Hz, available H2 2025, 1,000 hour service intervals, HVO and B100 capable) and the electronic 5012 (1,275 to 1,875 kVA at 50 Hz, 1,125 to 1,500 kWe at 60 Hz, ISO G3, NFPA110, EPA Tier 2 on 60 Hz). Applications cited: data centres, hospitals, power plants.
signals.analysis: The 5012 sits exactly on the 1,250 to 1,875 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSK50 and QSK60 based sets into data centres and hospitals, and it is offered to every independent packager in the Gulf. The 2606 attacks the 350 to 550 kVA band with 1,000 hour service intervals. Cummins Arabia should benchmark total cost of ownership against 5012-powered Jubaili and Teksan sets and lead with factory-packaged reliability, local service coverage and 50 degree C ambient performance.

signals.headline: Baudouin exhibits at Data Center Nation Riyadh with 2,000 to 5,250 kVA M33 and M55 gensets
signals.summary: Baudouin presented its data centre genset range and previewed the 20M55 to Saudi operators and developers, citing Uptime Institute pre-approval and ISO 8528 G3 load acceptance.
signals.analysis: Direct marketing into the Saudi data centre pipeline. Cummins Arabia should make sure Saudi data centre consultants and EPCs have Cummins DCC ratings, 60 Hz performance data and local service commitments in hand before Baudouin's lead-time pitch lands.

signals.headline: Baudouin launches complete generator sets for data centres, 2,000 to 5,250 kVA (baseline)
signals.summary: Baudouin moved from engines only to complete M33 and M55 gensets for data centres with Uptime Institute pre-approved units and announced the 20M55 genset (4,250 to 5,250 kVA). Manufacturing sites listed in India, China, Russia, Italy, Germany, France and the US.
signals.analysis: This is the structural change: Baudouin now bids as a single-brand genset supplier, not just an engine to local packagers, and it targets the same hyperscale and colocation buyers Cummins Arabia courts in Riyadh, Dammam, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Cummins Arabia should expect Baudouin gensets in consultant shortlists from 2025 onward.

signals.headline: FG Wilson Catalyst 2026: 60th anniversary global dealer conference in Belfast
signals.summary: FG Wilson gathered its global dealer network, customers and staff in Belfast's Titanic Quarter for a week of strategy, innovation and growth sessions and a Product Discovery Zone. No new product launches were announced.
signals.analysis: A dealer conference of this scale signals a channel re-energising exercise. Expect dealer targets and campaign activity in the Gulf over the next 12 months, especially from FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE and TAMGO. Cummins Arabia should expect sharper FG Wilson pricing in the 500 to 1,500 kVA commercial band.

signals.headline: Yuchai (China Yuchai International, Singapore HQ, NYSE CYD) is the second Chinese engine OEM whose genset engines appear in low-cost Gulf packages
signals.summary: China Yuchai International, through Guangxi Yuchai Machinery, produces engines for generator sets alongside marine and industrial engines. No verified 2025 to 2026 Gulf distributor announcement, Gulf project or data centre product from Yuchai was found in this research.
signals.analysis: Yuchai-powered sets from Chinese packagers compete at the low end of Gulf tenders (typically below 1,000 kVA). Cummins Arabia's exposure is in price-led utility, telecom and construction bids in KSA and Kuwait rather than in data centres. Track Chinese packager registrations on Etimad and CAPT rather than Yuchai itself.

signals.headline: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
signals.summary: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.
signals.analysis: KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.

signals.headline: Energy Vault signs 1.25 GW integrated power deal in Texas for a hyperscaler with an EPC deploying Caterpillar gensets
signals.summary: Energy Vault's largest contract to date: 1.25 GW of integrated power infrastructure in Texas for an AI data centre, with a power generation EPC deploying Caterpillar gensets and Energy Vault grid-forming BESS, initial deployments within 4 to 12 months.
signals.analysis: Third-party BESS integrators are packaging Cat gensets by default. In the Gulf, Cummins Arabia should court the BESS integrators and EPCs (not just end users) so that Cummins is the default genset in their bills of material.

signals.headline: Stella Power orders large quantity of Solar Turbines Titan 130 packages for data centre and industrial onsite power
signals.summary: Stella Power Company placed a large order for PGM130 packages (Titan 130 gas turbine, over 16 MW each, 90 second start, 2 ppm NOx capable) from Caterpillar's Solar Turbines for onsite power at data centres, industrial sites and oil and gas in North America.
signals.analysis: Cat can offer turbines above the reciprocating band, so in Gulf prime power tenders above 20 MW it can shift the buyer from gensets to turbines. Cummins Arabia should hold the reciprocating advantages (part-load efficiency, modular redundancy, N+1 flexibility) in its bid narrative.

signals.headline: H1 2026: Power Systems order intake +55% to GBP 4.6bn, power generation revenue +41%, margin 20.3%
signals.summary: Underlying revenue GBP 2,604m (+28% organic), operating profit GBP 528m, book-to-bill 1.8x, OE order cover about 100% for 2026 and over 50% for 2027. Rolls-Royce raised its power generation OE growth outlook to 25% a year through 2030 and cited Series 4000 gas prime power demand in data centres. CFO McCabe cited 50% plus data centre order growth.
signals.analysis: mtu is sold out for 2026 and half sold for 2027. Any Gulf project needing Series 4000 sets inside 12 months will struggle to get mtu slots, which is a direct window for Cummins Arabia to win on delivery in UAE and KSA data centre and utility tenders through 2027.

signals.headline: US state data centre moratoria (New York EO 62, New Jersey cost-sharing law) trigger Baird downgrade, CAT falls over 6%
signals.summary: New York signed a moratorium on hyperscale data centres above 50 MW pending review and New Jersey passed a cost-sharing law; at least 12 states have moratorium bills; Baird downgraded Caterpillar citing regulatory risk to power generator demand.
signals.analysis: If US data centre permitting slows, Cat will redirect gensets and sales focus to the Gulf where Saudi and UAE AI campuses face no such moratoria. That raises competitive intensity in KSA and UAE from late 2026. Cummins Arabia should assume more aggressive Cat dealer pricing on large nodes.

signals.headline: Baudouin partners with EODev on solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) power, commercial launch September 2026
signals.summary: EODev will roll out Baudouin SOFC continuous baseload power across Europe with exclusive rights in France and Poland. Weichai's SOFC system holds EU CE certification with over 65 percent electrical efficiency and Weichai deepened its Ceres Power collaboration in November 2025.
signals.analysis: Europe only for now, but SOFC baseload for data centres is the kind of grid-independent offer Gulf hyperscalers will ask about as grid connection queues lengthen. Cummins Arabia should track whether Baudouin brings SOFC to Middle East Energy 2027.

signals.headline: Rehlko invests EUR 12 million to expand Cholet, France switchgear plant
signals.summary: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.
signals.analysis: Rehlko is shortening lead times on the paralleling switchgear that ships with large genset packages to EMEA including the Gulf. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own switchgear lead times and partner capacity so it is not outpaced on complete package delivery.

signals.headline: Mitsubishi Power wins boiler supply for heavy oil to gas fuel conversion at Jeddah South and Shuqaiq plants
signals.summary: Contract from Saudi Energy for dual fuel conversion of four units at each of two 2.9 GW west coast plants, with Dar Al Balad as local EPC and Mitsubishi Corporation Machinery as agent.
signals.analysis: Context only: it deepens Mitsubishi's standing with Saudi utility buyers and local EPCs. No genset scope. Cummins Arabia should note that Dar Al Balad and similar EPCs now have a working Mitsubishi relationship that could extend to backup power packages.

signals.headline: Mankato logistics centre opens; Series 4000 genset capacity more than doubles by end 2026
signals.summary: Rolls-Royce cut the ribbon on the 250,000 sq ft, USD 24 million Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, stating genset production capacity more than doubles by end of 2026 and that its backup systems support more than 25% of US data centres.
signals.analysis: Doubled 60 Hz Series 4000 output is the supply side of a future push into Saudi Arabia's 60 Hz data centre market. Lead time, not product, has been mtu's Gulf weakness; from 2027 that argument weakens for Cummins Arabia in KSA.

signals.headline: Generac promotes Niccolo Borracchini to EVP International (Generac and Pramac outside US and Canada)
signals.summary: Borracchini, with Pramac since 2015 and SVP International since 2024, now leads EMEA, APAC and LATAM; Paolo Campinoti retired 2026-07-01 to an advisory role.
signals.analysis: A Pramac-rooted leader running international suggests the Gulf will be served through the Pramac Dubai structure. Cummins Arabia should track whether PR Middle East FZE begins quoting large Generac data centre sets in UAE and KSA.

signals.headline: Zahid Tractor publishes updated Saudi branch map (22 to 24 branches) and a 75 years of partnership campaign
signals.analysis: Zahid's network already covers every Saudi industrial cluster including the northern and southern regions where Cummins Arabia has thinner coverage. Any Cummins Arabia branch plan should be checked against this map to avoid opening where Cat service is already dense and to prioritise gaps.

signals.headline: MHIET 500 kW class 100% hydrogen engine generator set reaches commercial readiness level
signals.summary: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.
signals.analysis: Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.

signals.headline: Rehlko integrates WB Power Services into its UK and EMEA platform
signals.summary: WB Power Services, acquired August 2025, was integrated into a unified Rehlko EMEA operating model spanning design, installation, testing and service. Lenaik Andrieux named as General Manager EMEA, India and LATAM.
signals.analysis: The EMEA leadership now runs a standardised delivery model that can be extended to the Middle East through distributors. Cummins Arabia should expect more consistent Rehlko bids on Gulf data centre tenders led by UK and European consultants.

signals.headline: Generac buys Belvidere, Illinois plant to add large-megawatt genset packaging capacity from Q1 2027, after February 2026 Enercon acquisition
signals.summary: The facility adds over 100 jobs and follows the acquisition of Enercon Engineering (enclosures and switchgear) and expansions in Oshkosh, Beaver Dam and Sussex.
signals.analysis: More US packaging capacity shortens Generac lead times for export orders in 2027. Cummins Arabia should expect Generac to quote competitive delivery on Gulf hyperscale sites from 2027.

signals.headline: MHI-ESA headline partner at DCD Connect APAC 2026, pitching MGS-R and grid-to-chip resilience
signals.summary: MHI-ESA presented MGS-R innovations and one-stop data centre solutions for AI and HPC workloads in Bali.
signals.analysis: Mitsubishi is marketing MGS as an AI data centre product in Asia. The same hyperscale and colocation operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should track which APAC operators standardise on MGS and prepare Gulf-specific counters.

signals.headline: Generac SD3250 (3.25 MW, Baudouin Baudouin M55) wins Consulting-Specifying Engineer 2026 gold award; large diesel series 1.75 to 3.25 MW
signals.summary: The 3.25 MW unit is Generac's largest diesel set, part of a new large diesel series from 1.75 to 3.25 MW built for data centres, healthcare and infrastructure.
signals.analysis: The series maps onto Cummins Arabia's C2000 to C3500 data centre band. Note the engine is Baudouin, so the product competes on Generac packaging and Baudouin lead time, not on a proprietary engine.

signals.headline: Rehlko opens Kenosha, Wisconsin assembly for eFRAME enclosures up to 4 MW
signals.summary: New facility for integrated eFRAME enclosures for backup generator solutions up to 4 MW, with plans to expand capacity by more than 400% through the decade; initial production late 2026, full capacity early 2027.
signals.analysis: Capacity is being added for enclosed 4 MW packages, the format hyperscalers specify. This is North American capacity, so lead time relief for Gulf orders would come from Brest and Changzhou instead. Cummins Arabia should track quoted lead times from Rehlko distributors on 2.5 MW to 4 MW enclosed sets.

signals.headline: FG Wilson gensets pass HVO field trials with Tria Energy
signals.summary: FG Wilson Engineering (Dublin) Ltd and Tria Energy reported diesel-equivalent performance on HVO (EN 15940) across load conditions with no engine or fuel system changes, up to 90 percent lifecycle CO2 savings, aimed at data centre, construction and critical infrastructure customers.
signals.analysis: HVO acceptance is becoming a standard question in data centre tenders in the UAE. FG Wilson now has published trial evidence to cite. Cummins Arabia should have equivalent HVO approval statements for its data centre range ready in tender documents.

signals.headline: Rehlko introduces next-generation APM804 control platform
signals.summary: New controller aimed at the complexity, scale and resilience requirements of modern data centres; APM804 now appears as a standard controller option on KD spec sheets.
signals.analysis: Controls and paralleling are a decision factor for data centre consultants. Cummins Arabia should ensure PowerCommand paralleling and monitoring capabilities are presented head to head with APM804 in consultant briefings.

signals.headline: PROPWR signs framework with Caterpillar for at least 1.5 GW of gas generation assets, option to about 2.1 GW
signals.summary: ProPetro's PROPWR division agreed to buy at least 1.5 GW of Caterpillar power generation assets over five years with an option to about 2.1 GW, for about 2.6 GW operating by end 2031 including 550 MW already ordered, serving data centres, oil and gas and industry.
signals.analysis: Cat is locking multi-year framework volume with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf equivalents (Altaaqa, Aggreko type players and Saudi IPP developers) are the accounts where Cummins Arabia should propose its own multi-year fleet frameworks before Cat dealers do.

signals.headline: Generac Q1 2026: C&I sales up 28 percent on data centre demand; final-stage vendor approval with multiple hyperscalers
signals.summary: Net sales rose 12 percent to US$1.06 billion, C&I external sales rose about 28 percent to US$510 million, and Generac raised full-year guidance to mid-to-high teens growth with C&I in the mid-to-high 20s percent.
signals.analysis: Confirms Generac is becoming a scale supplier of large data centre gensets. For Cummins Arabia this is a new name on hyperscaler approved vendor lists rather than an immediate local competitor.

signals.headline: Volvo Penta publishes data centre backup power positioning: Tier 4 Final platform, modular approach, independent partner to OEMs and system integrators
signals.summary: Volvo Penta states it collaborates with OEMs and system integrators on flexible data centre backup power, cites automotive-scale production for shorter lead times, stackable modular configurations and HVO100 compatibility for all engines built since 2016.
signals.analysis: Volvo's data centre pitch is modular many-small-units, which fits edge and enterprise sites rather than the hyperscale campuses driving Gulf demand. Cummins Arabia should watch packager bids on edge data centres in UAE.

signals.headline: FG Wilson lists new 'M' variants across the large range (P1100-1M to P2500-3M) with DSE7410 control
signals.summary: FG Wilson's large range pages now pair each legacy model with an M variant (P1100-1M, P1650-1M, P2250-3M, P2500-3M), all on Perkins 4008, 4012 and 4016 engines, FG Wilson alternators with AREP excitation and Deep Sea 7410 controllers, with new datasheets dated 2024-10 and 2026-03.
signals.analysis: FG Wilson's top end remains 2,500 kVA on the mechanical 4016-61TRG3 while the electronic 5016 is sold to other packagers. Cummins Arabia's C2500 to C3500 range and its factory data centre ratings remain a differentiator above 2,500 kVA and in DCC rated applications. Below 2,500 kVA expect the refreshed FG Wilson range to be pushed hard by TAMGO and FG Wilson FZE.

signals.headline: Perkins shows 2600 Series, hydrogen hybrid IOPU and battery-electric power unit at CONEXPO 2026
signals.summary: Perkins announced the 904J-E36TTA (129 kW), the 13 litre 2600 Series (340 to 515 kW, Stage V and Tier 4 Final), Project Coeus hydrogen hybrid IOPU (379 kW combined) and a 95.5 kW battery-electric power unit. Richard Hemmings, VP and GM Global Sales, Marketing, Service and Parts, framed the message as lower total cost of ownership and future fuel readiness.
signals.analysis: Hybrid and alternative fuel work is still at prototype stage for Perkins and is aimed at off-highway more than gensets. The relevant signal is the Stage V 2600 Series, which packagers can pair with Gulf tenders that start asking for Stage V or Tier 4 Final in urban and data centre sites. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Stage V and Tier 4 Final genset offer visible to consultants in UAE and KSA.

signals.headline: MHI-ESA terminates Indonesia dealership for MGS-G gas generator sets
signals.summary: Formal termination notice for the MGS-G dealership arrangement in Indonesia.
signals.analysis: Shows Mitsubishi actively manages its gas genset channel. In the Middle East MGS-G is sold direct by MHIES-ME with no local dealer, so gas genset coverage in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is thin. Cummins Arabia's gas offer faces little Mitsubishi channel pressure.

signals.headline: Caterpillar, OnePWR Solutions and Vero3 collaborate on 500 MW gas power with carbon capture for data centres
signals.summary: Caterpillar supplies generation and leads front-end engineering for carbon capture, OnePWR builds, owns and operates, Vero3 handles CO2 storage; inaugural project targets 500 MW of prime power launching in 2026.
signals.analysis: Gas plus carbon capture is a decarbonisation answer Gulf regulators and NEOM-type clients will ask for. Cummins Arabia has no equivalent bundled offer; it should decide whether to partner for capture or lean on HVO and hydrogen-ready messaging.

signals.headline: FY2025: Power Systems revenue GBP 4.9bn (+19%), margin 17.4%, data centre revenue +35%, order cover 79% for 2026
signals.summary: Power generation revenue grew 30% and data centre revenue 35% in 2025; order intake GBP 6.1bn (+21%), book-to-bill 1.2x. Rolls-Royce guides power generation revenue growth of around 20% a year driven by data centres, doubled US genset capacity, and a next-generation Series 4000 with 20% higher power density launching 2028.
signals.analysis: mtu is entering 2026 with most of its genset slots sold and margins rising, so it will not chase price in Gulf tenders; it will chase specification and hyperscaler relationships. Cummins Arabia can win on availability and total cost in 2026 but should plan for a more aggressive mtu from 2027 when new capacity frees up.

signals.headline: Rolls-Royce reports over 80% Saudisation and 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi fleets ahead of World Defense Show 2026
signals.summary: Rolls-Royce said Saudi nationals are over 80% of its Kingdom workforce, cited 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi naval and government fleets and the 50 high-speed train engines, and named Makeen as its local power solutions joint venture with its own WDS stand.
signals.analysis: Rolls-Royce is packaging aerospace, naval and mtu activity into one Saudi localisation story, which is how it will approach GAMI, SAMI and PIF-linked buyers of power equipment. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own Saudi headcount, training and local content so procurement teams see a comparable Vision 2030 narrative.

signals.headline: Volvo Penta reports doubled industrial engine sales in North America and targets the data centre boom
signals.summary: Volvo Penta said North American industrial engine sales doubled and highlighted backup power and BESS solutions for data centres ahead of CONEXPO 2026.
signals.analysis: Growth is US-led. No Gulf-specific volume signal found.

signals.headline: AIP Corp, Caterpillar and Boyd CAT form alliance for 2 GW of G3516 gas gensets plus BESS at Monarch Compute Campus, 8 GW planned
signals.summary: American Intelligence & Power Corp announced 2 GW of fast-response Cat G3516 natural gas gensets with battery storage and SCR for a West Virginia AI campus, deliveries September 2026 to August 2027, 2 GW online 2027, 8 GW planned in total.
signals.analysis: Cat's G3516 is being positioned as prime power infrastructure, not standby. If Gulf hyperscale developers such as those building for Humain or Khazna adopt behind-the-meter gas, Cat arrives with a referenceable multi-GW installed base. Cummins Arabia should build its own gas prime power references now.

signals.headline: Zahid Tractor runs 2026 Sales Campus with Caterpillar management at Zahid Business Park
signals.summary: Three-day Sales Campus (13 to 15 January 2026) for the full Zahid sales organisation, product support, SMD and Ejar rental divisions with Caterpillar management and instructors, built around a customer-back approach, VisionLink, Cat Inspect and uptime guarantees.
signals.analysis: Zahid is standardising a digital, uptime-guarantee sales motion across machines, power and rental in the Kingdom. Cummins Arabia should expect connected-asset and uptime-guarantee terms to appear in Saudi genset bids and should have PowerCommand Cloud and service-level commitments ready as standard.

signals.headline: Volvo Penta introduces G17 natural gas engine for power generation, aimed at data centres and utilities
signals.summary: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.
signals.analysis: Adds a gas option at the 17 litre node for packagers. In the Gulf the relevant overlap is with Cummins gas gensets in the 400 to 700 kW band for oil and gas and utility sites in KSA and Kuwait.

signals.headline: First emergency gensets with verified Environmental Product Declarations: 16V4000 DS2500 and 10V1600
signals.summary: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.
signals.analysis: EPDs will be asked for by hyperscalers and by UAE and Saudi green building schemes. If a UAE data centre RFP requires EPDs, Cummins Arabia needs Cummins' equivalent documentation ready or it loses on a compliance line rather than on price.

signals.headline: Five-year guaranteed Series 4000 capacity agreement with UK packager AVK
signals.summary: Framework agreement secures Series 4000 emergency genset production capacity for AVK, exclusive mtu integrator for UK and Ireland, for five years, focused on HVO-ready data centre gensets. AVK has taken over 600 mtu gensets in the past decade.
signals.analysis: Rolls-Royce is pre-selling Series 4000 capacity to European data centre packagers. That is good for Cummins Arabia in the short term because it leaves less uncommitted mtu volume for Gulf distributors, but it also signals mtu will prioritise hyperscaler channel partners; if a Gulf packager gets a similar deal, treat it as a direct threat.

signals.headline: Rehlko launches all-new KD Series 60 to 600 kW generators
signals.summary: Rehlko extended the KD brand down into the 60 to 600 kW range, presenting it as a global standard in 80 to 600 kW power and consolidating its industrial lineup under one brand.
signals.analysis: Below 600 kW is outside the large genset band but this unifies Rehlko's catalogue for distributors, which simplifies their selling and service story in the Gulf. Cummins Arabia's C-series coverage in the same band remains broader, and it should hold price discipline rather than react.

signals.headline: Volvo Penta positions itself as total power solutions provider for the digital infrastructure market at CONEXPO 2026
signals.summary: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.
signals.analysis: KJ Power is a Turkish packager active in Gulf tenders; Volvo BESS subsystems inside packager products would compete with Cummins BESS in rental and hybrid applications.

signals.headline: Rehlko and Alghanem deliver data centre backup power in Jordan
signals.summary: DCD reported a Jordan data centre backup power project delivered by Rehlko with Alghanem Trading and Contracting, its exclusive Jordan distributor for over 25 years. Capacity and models were not published. The article also states Rehlko ranks third globally in generator manufacturing.
signals.analysis: This is the closest published Rehlko data centre reference to the Gulf. It shows Rehlko using long-tenured regional distributors for data centre wins in the Levant. The same Midis Group channel that serves Jordan also serves KSA, UAE and Kuwait, so replication in the Gulf is plausible.

signals.headline: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar exhibit together at ADIPEC 2025 in Abu Dhabi
signals.summary: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar shared stand 9430 at ADIPEC 2025 (3 to 6 November, ADNEC), showcasing high-efficiency engines, rebuild programmes and data-driven lifecycle solutions for oil and gas customers.
signals.analysis: Cat is keeping its oil and gas power and marine franchise warm with ADNOC-ecosystem buyers through the dealer. Cummins Arabia should track ADNOC and Lamprell type accounts where Al-Bahar has installed 3500 series sets and target the rebuild and CVA renewal cycle.

signals.headline: Generac standardises 1,000 to 1,500 kW US industrial diesel sets on Perkins 4008 (30.6 L) and 4012/D46L (45.8 L) engines
signals.summary: Generac's SD1000/MD1000 use the Perkins 30.6 L 8 cylinder engine and the SD1250/MD1250 (1,250 and 1,500 kW nodes) use the Perkins D46L 12 cylinder engine with Deep Sea G8601 controllers.
signals.analysis: Perkins gains a large 60 Hz OEM volume base through Generac, which feeds 60 Hz product maturity relevant to Saudi Arabia. If Generac's Gulf dealers (Atlas Power Solutions, Watan Altaqa, Al Mulla) bring these sets to KSA, Cummins Arabia faces Perkins-powered 1,000 to 1,500 kW packages under a second brand.

signals.headline: Q3 2025: record USD 17.6 billion sales, Energy & Transportation USD 8.4 billion (+17%), backlog USD 39.8 billion led by data centre customers
signals.summary: Caterpillar posted all-time Q3 sales of USD 17.6 billion, Energy & Transportation sales of USD 8.4 billion up 17%, backlog up USD 2.4 billion in the quarter mainly from data centre customers, and full-year tariff cost guidance of USD 1.6 to 1.75 billion.
signals.analysis: Backlog growth driven by data centres means Cat factory slots are being consumed by US hyperscalers. In the near term this leaves room for Cummins Arabia on lead time in the Gulf; the window narrows as Cat capacity comes online.

signals.headline: Mitsubishi Power unveils first locally assembled M501JAC gas turbine at Dammam, marking 60 years in Saudi Arabia
signals.summary: The Dammam facility assembled its first JAC turbine, destined for the 475 MW Amiral cogeneration plant in Jubail (TAQA and JERA) serving SATORP. Mitsubishi Power reports over 50% Saudisation and partnerships with Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC.
signals.analysis: Mitsubishi Power's Saudi localisation is in gas turbines, not gensets, but it gives the Mitsubishi name Vision 2030 credibility with Aramco, SEC and the Eastern Province. If MHIET ever routes MGS assembly or service through Dammam, that would be a direct challenge. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Saudi localisation and IKTVA content visible to the same buyers.

signals.headline: MHI-ESA launches containerised MGS2500R for data centres
signals.summary: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.
signals.analysis: A plug-in containerised 2.5 MVA set is the format UAE and Kuwait colocation builders ask for. Cummins Arabia should have a matching containerised C2500 or C2750 offer priced and documented for 50 Hz markets before Mitsubishi dealers bring this to Dubai.

signals.headline: Largest ever mtu battery order: 582 MWh / 291 MW EnergyPack for Ignitis in Lithuania
signals.summary: Three BESS sites at wind farms and a pumped storage plant, operational from 2027, controlled by mtu EnergetIQ Manager. Rolls-Royce cites over 200 mtu battery storage projects delivered worldwide.
signals.analysis: mtu's BESS business is grid-scale and utility-led, unlike Cummins' BESS positioning. The relevance for Cummins Arabia is hybrid genset plus storage tenders in KSA and UAE, where mtu can now show half-gigawatt-hour references and its own controller. Cummins Arabia should track EnergyPack quotes into Saudi utility and NEOM-type microgrid work.

signals.headline: Rolls-Royce and Microsoft publish joint position paper on HVO for data centre backup power
signals.summary: The paper positions HVO as a drop-in fuel cutting lifecycle CO2 by up to 90% on approved diesel gensets, written for the Singapore data centre sector with Microsoft's APAC cloud ESG team. Quoted: Ostermaier and Spadaro.
signals.analysis: A published Microsoft co-authorship is a hyperscaler endorsement mtu will reuse in UAE and Saudi data centre bids where Microsoft, and the operators building for it, specify backup fleets. Cummins Arabia should be ready with its own HVO approval documentation for the QSK series when hyperscaler specs arrive.

signals.headline: 50 mtu 12V4000 R64 engines ordered for Saudi Arabia's Dammam to Riyadh high-speed trains
signals.summary: Stadler ordered 50 mtu Series 4000 rail engines (1,500 kW each, EU Stage V) for 10 trains running up to 200 km/h, with an option for 40 more. The release stresses operation in extreme heat and sand.
signals.analysis: Not a genset sale, but it puts 50 plus Series 4000 engines into Saudi Arabia with a service obligation, which strengthens the case for a Makeen Series 4000 parts and MRO base in the Eastern Province. That base would also serve stationary Series 4000 gensets sold against Cummins Arabia's QSK60 and QSK78 range.

signals.headline: Caterpillar launches Cat D1500 1.5 MW compact diesel genset on C32B engine
signals.summary: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.
signals.analysis: A 1.5 MW node on a 32 litre engine attacks the footprint and weight argument in the 1,500 to 1,875 kVA class where Cummins sells QSK50 based sets in Saudi 60 Hz projects. Watch for a 50 Hz and Middle East release; until then it is a North America product.

signals.headline: Joule, Caterpillar and Wheeler agree 4 GW data centre power in Utah on G3520K gensets with 1.1 GWh BESS
signals.summary: Joule Capital Partners, Caterpillar and dealer Wheeler Machinery announced an agreement for 4 GW of total energy for a 4,000 acre data centre campus in central Utah, using G3520K gas gensets with combined cooling heat and power and 1.1 GWh of grid-forming battery storage, launch targeted 2026.
signals.analysis: This is the template Cat will bring to Gulf data centre developers: gas gensets as prime power plus BESS in one dealer-led package. Cummins Arabia needs an equivalent prime power gas plus storage story for Saudi and UAE campuses before Cat dealers pitch it.

signals.headline: MTU Yuchai Power JV in Suzhou adds Series 2000 G06 and Series 4000 S83 production, 3,000 engines built to date
signals.summary: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.
signals.analysis: Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf. Cummins Arabia already competes with Chinese packaged Cummins engines from Cummins' own China plants; mtu now has a comparable lever. Watch for Suzhou sourced mtu gensets appearing in UAE and KSA rental and construction tenders.

signals.headline: Rehlko completes acquisition of The Wilmott Group (WB Power Services and Wiltech Acoustics)
signals.summary: UK critical power integrator with 19 UK locations supporting over 4,000 critical power plants joined Rehlko, adding project engineering, acoustic enclosures and lifecycle service to its EMEA data centre offer.
signals.analysis: Rehlko is building an end-to-end data centre delivery model in EMEA (engineering, enclosures, commissioning, service) rather than selling loose gensets. Gulf hyperscale customers procuring through UK and European consultants will see this offer. Cummins Arabia should be ready to quote full turnkey scope, not equipment only.

signals.headline: USD 75 million Aiken, South Carolina expansion to machine Series 4000 engines in the US from July 2027
signals.summary: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.
signals.analysis: A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year. Monitor mtu lead-time quotes in KSA and UAE from 2027.

signals.headline: MHIET launches 450 kW gas cogeneration system capable of hydrogen co-firing
signals.summary: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.
signals.analysis: Small gas CHP is a Japan-first product. Gulf relevance is limited today but it signals Mitsubishi will pitch hydrogen-ready gas engines into Saudi and UAE decarbonisation programmes where Cummins gas gensets also compete.

signals.headline: USD 24 million Mankato expansion to lift Series 4000 genset output by more than 120% by 2026
signals.summary: Rolls-Royce announced a new Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, Minnesota to raise Series 4000 generator set production more than 120% by 2026 versus the prior year, adding over 100 jobs. Data centre sales grew almost 50% in 2024; Stratmann said hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years.
signals.analysis: Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on. More 60 Hz Series 4000 capacity shortens the lead times mtu can quote into Saudi data centre and industrial tenders from 2026. Cummins Arabia's 60 Hz lead-time advantage in KSA narrows as this ramps.

signals.headline: Jubaili Bros (Perkins packager) signs strategic partnership with Wholesale Electric Asia for oil and gas power packages
signals.summary: Jubaili Bros (1,600 employees, 11 countries, 3 manufacturing plants, 1.5 GW annual capacity) and Singapore based WEA agreed to cooperate on power generation distribution and customised oil and gas packages across the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia.
signals.analysis: Jubaili Bros is scaling as a regional packager and now targets oil and gas packages, a core Cummins Arabia segment in KSA and Kuwait. Its Perkins-based JP range runs to 2,250 kVA prime. Cummins Arabia should monitor Jubaili's Saudi factory ramp and its bids into Aramco contractor and rental fleets.

signals.headline: Rehlko and Liebherr expand KD Series engine partnership
signals.summary: Rehlko announced an expanded partnership with Liebherr for next generation KD Series generators, securing engine supply for the range that competes with Cummins QSK series in the 1 MW to 4 MW band.
signals.analysis: The KD engine is a Liebherr-derived design, so Rehlko depends on a single external engine partner for its flagship range. Cummins Arabia can position Cummins in-house engine design, manufacturing and Gulf parts stock as a supply certainty argument in tenders.

signals.headline: MHI-ESA adds MGS assembly plant in Johor Bahru, Malaysia with WDG Assembly
signals.summary: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.
signals.analysis: Extra MGS capacity in Asia shortens lead times for Gulf orders that ship from Singapore. Cummins Arabia should expect Mitsubishi dealers in KSA and UAE to quote firmer delivery on 1.5 MVA to 2.75 MVA sets.

signals.headline: Upgraded mtu Series 1600 gensets launched for 50 Hz market, 590 to 996 kVA
signals.summary: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.
signals.analysis: This pushes mtu down into the 600 to 1,000 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in volume for UAE and Kuwait 50 Hz projects. mtu's argument is data centre grade load factors and HVO approval on a compact 22 litre engine. Cummins Arabia should hold the position on price, lead time and local stock, which mtu's distributors cannot match in this band.

signals.headline: Zahid Tractor marks 75 years as Caterpillar's Saudi dealer at Jeddah flagship branch
signals.summary: Zahid Tractor and Caterpillar executives, key clients and employees from across the Kingdom gathered at the Jeddah flagship branch to mark 75 years of the dealership, coinciding with Caterpillar's 2025 centennial.
signals.analysis: The Zahid relationship is the deepest dealer franchise in the Kingdom and is not going to be disrupted. Cummins Arabia should not expect Cat account churn in KSA from dealer instability; wins have to come on product, lead time and service economics.

signals.headline: Jubaili Bros adds MWM gas gensets (400 to 4,500 kW) for Middle East and Africa
signals.summary: MWM (Mannheim) and Jubaili Bros (Dubai) announced a partnership to offer MWM gas generators of 400 to 4,500 kW electrical across MEA, under Group CEO Dr Marcus Schumacher.
signals.analysis: This is context for the Perkins channel: Jubaili now covers diesel (Perkins) and gas (MWM), which lets it bid full gas and diesel packages against Cummins Arabia's HSK78G and diesel range. Included as a late 2024 baseline because it shapes 2025 to 2026 bidding behaviour.

signals.headline: Kohler Energy rebrands as Rehlko under Platinum Equity ownership
signals.summary: Platinum Equity completed its acquisition of a majority stake in May 2024 and the business took the Rehlko name on 17 September 2024, with Kohler Co. remaining an investment partner. Portfolio listed as Power Systems, Engines, Uninterruptible Power, Home Energy, Clarke Energy, Curtis Instruments and Heila Technologies, across 100 plus locations.
signals.analysis: Private equity ownership means Rehlko is being run for growth and exit, with capital allocated to data centre gensets. The Kohler-SDMO brand equity in the Gulf is being migrated to Rehlko, which creates a window where distributor and end-user recognition is weaker. Cummins Arabia should press its brand continuity with consultants and data centre EPCs during this transition.

signals.headline: Baudouin joins the Gulf Data Centre Association (GCDA) alongside Italian and Spanish data centre associations (baseline)
signals.summary: Baudouin announced collaborations with GCDA (covering Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE), IDA (Italy) and SPAIN DC, promoting M Series engines 25 to 4,150 kVA with cooling above 50 degree C ambient and HVO testing.
signals.analysis: GCDA membership gives Baudouin a seat in the Gulf data centre community and its events. Cummins Arabia should confirm its own visibility in GCDA programmes so Baudouin does not become the default OEM voice there.

signals.headline: MHIET launches MGS3100R, a 3,000 kVA class set with common rail S16R2 engine
signals.summary: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.
signals.analysis: This is Mitsubishi's answer to the 2.5 MW to 3 MW data centre node that Cummins serves with QSK78 and QSK95 based sets. It is not yet on the Middle East catalogue, which caps Mitsubishi's Gulf offer at 2,750 kVA until MHIES-ME adopts MGS-R. Cummins Arabia should keep quoting above 2.75 MVA where Mitsubishi cannot follow locally.

signals.headline: Volvo Penta launches D17, its most powerful genset engine (TWD1744GE, 758 kVA prime at 50 Hz) (baseline)
signals.summary: 17.26 litre six cylinder with dual-stage turbochargers and common rail, EPA Tier 2 certified for stationary emergency, dual speed 1500/1800 rpm, service interval up to 1,000 hours; 50 Hz prime 758 kVA, standby 833 kVA; 60 Hz prime 801 kVA, standby 881 kVA.
signals.analysis: Lifts Volvo's ceiling to about 880 kVA standby at 60 Hz, which puts Volvo-powered packager sets against Cummins QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in Saudi commercial and industrial standby. Above that band Volvo has no offer.

signals.headline: FG Wilson appoints Roger Kennedy as General Manager
signals.summary: Roger Kennedy, a 30 year FG Wilson veteran with a commercial background, was appointed General Manager to lead the FG Wilson team worldwide.
signals.analysis: A commercially oriented GM tends to prioritise dealer growth and volume. Combined with the Catalyst 2026 conference, this points to a growth push rather than a hold strategy for FG Wilson.

signals.headline: Volvo Penta adds D13 power node TAD1346GE 500 kVA
signals.summary: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.
signals.analysis: 500 kVA is the most contested packager node in the Gulf commercial market; a D13 at 500 kVA competes with Cummins QSX15 based sets on price through packagers.

signals.headline: Al Mulla Power Solutions adds Generac as a second genset brand alongside mtu in Kuwait
signals.summary: AMPS signed with Generac Power Systems to distribute diesel, gas and bi-fuel gensets for residential, commercial and industrial customers in Kuwait, with 24/7 after-sales support.
signals.analysis: Al Mulla is now a multi-brand house covering small Generac sets up to large mtu units, which dilutes focus but also means it will compete across Cummins Arabia's whole Kuwait range. The opportunity is that mtu no longer has a dedicated Kuwait partner; Cummins Arabia can position single-brand accountability with Kuwait government and oil sector buyers.

signals.headline: MHI-ESA hosts MGS Sales and Service Maintenance Conference 2026 for Asia Pacific dealers in Bali
signals.summary: Dealer network conference under the theme 'Preserving Excellence. Engineered, Not Accidental'; Diamond Dealer awards to Malaysian, Indonesian and Hong Kong dealers. Middle East dealers were not referenced.
signals.analysis: Mitsubishi's dealer development effort is centred on Asia Pacific; the Middle East network is small (one dealer per Gulf country) and run from Sharjah. Cummins Arabia's branch depth in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is a clear service argument against MGS in tenders that score after-sales coverage.

signals.headline: Rehlko and INNIO sign multi-year framework for 1.25 GW of gas engines
signals.summary: Three-year framework agreement allocating 1.25 GW of INNIO gas engine capacity to Rehlko, delivered through Clarke Energy as integrated gas genset plus BESS hybrid solutions for hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data centres and flexible generation in constrained grids, within Clarke Energy's authorised territories.
signals.analysis: The agreement is confined to Clarke Energy territories, and Clarke Energy lists no office in KSA, UAE or Kuwait. Gulf gas genset demand from data centres and grid constrained sites therefore has no Rehlko gas channel today. Cummins Arabia should push HSK78G and gas genset packages into Gulf data centre and utility bids before Rehlko or another INNIO packager fills that gap.
